title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Join athenahealth as a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a newly formed engineering team advancing our Integration Platform. You will build and develop the team, guide technical direction, and own the delivery of scalable, reliable integration solutions.
  
  
Working closely with engineering, product, architecture, and operational stakeholders, you will help simplify healthcare data exchange and improve the experience of developers, customers, and integration partners. A key focus will be advancing automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve engineering productivity.
  
  
**Team Summary**
The Integration Platform is part of the athenahealth Data and Ecosystem Platform subdivision. It supports internal data exchanges and connections between athenahealth and laboratories, imaging providers, registries, health information exchanges (HIEs), payers, other electronic health record (EHR) systems, faxing services, and third-party vendors serving healthcare practices.
  
  
A core component is our proprietary HL7 engine, which supports more than 15,000 contexts, approximately 20,000 connections, and millions of subscriptions. These connections use protocols and connectivity methods such as SFTP, HTTPS, APIs, and VPN sockets, making scalability, performance, and reliability central to the team’s work.
  
  
The platform supports inbound and outbound HL7 connections, alongside custom integrations for specific customer needs. Self-service tools and a dedicated advisory team support the onboarding, development, and validation of new integrations.
  
  
The Chennai team will expand these capabilities through platform improvements, process automation, and AI-powered tools that simplify integration development, testing, and onboarding.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices across planning, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance, with appropriate engineering review and quality controls.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, self-service, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve developer and customer experiences.
* Establish and track meaningful measures of delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and integration turnaround time.
* Lead the evolution of existing systems while supporting new functionality and maintaining operational continuity.
* Foster agile / AIDLC development practices and use delivery outcomes and team feedback to improve how the team works.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Coach and mentor engineers through regular feedback, career development, and opportunities to strengthen technical and leadership skills.
* Own engineering planning and delivery for integration and faxing solutions, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Partner with product, architecture, and engineering leaders to translate business objectives into a technical roadmap and achievable delivery plans.
* Guide architectural decisions and engineering practices that improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the long-term architecture and modernization strategy for the Integration Platform.
* Lead recruiting, onboarding, and talent development to build the capabilities needed for the team’s roadmap.
* Partner with operational and advisory teams to identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Maintain productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and vendors.
* Support production readiness, incident resolution, and follow-up improvements that strengthen platform reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI development tools through focused experiments with measurable outcomes.
* Share technical knowledge and effective engineering practices across teams.

**Expected Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* At least 12 years of experience across software development and engineering leadership, including experience managing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop teams, manage performance, and deliver complex software initiatives.
* Strong technical background in Java and experience designing, developing, or operating scalable enterprise software.
* Experience guiding architectural decisions, managing technical trade-offs, and improving software quality and operational reliability.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and opportunities to apply AI and automation to engineering workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical audiences

title: Senior Manager Continuous Improvement
description:
**Vestas is well-known in wind technology and actively contributes to its development. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Quality Management System > Quality Audit > Continuous Improvement**
The Continuous Improvement head leads the organization's efforts to deliver sustainable quality and performance improvements across the value chain. The role facilitates and enables continuous quality improvement through structured, data-driven methodologies, close stakeholder collaboration, and customer-focused problem-solving.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the global Continuous Improvement strategy aligned with business and quality objectives
* Facilitate and enable continuous quality improvements across the entire value chain, from product development through manufacturing, supply chain, and service operations
* Direct complex, cross-functional quality improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving and data-driven methodologies
* Oversee global and value chain-specific improvement programs to enhance quality, delivery, cost, and customer satisfaction performance
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders, customers, and functional leaders to identify improvement opportunities and ensure effective implementation
* Anchor and govern continuous improvement frameworks, standards, and best practices across the organization
* Utilize data analytics, quality metrics, and performance dashboards to prioritize initiatives and measure impact
* Build organizational capability in 8D, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and other continuous improvement methodologies
* Ensure improvement actions are effectively translated into sustainable business results and measurable quality performance gains
* Govern the improvement project portfolio, track benefits realization, and communicate progress to senior leadership
* Support strategic business transformation initiatives by embedding continuous improvement principles into daily operations

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in any engineering field
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in leadership experience in solving complex quality issues & overseeing an improvement project portfolio
* Leadership experience in solving complex quality issues & managing an improvement project portfolio
* Leadership experience in overseeing strategic initiatives, change management, business process improvement, and deployment
* Change management and stakeholder management
* Practical experience in running Global 8D, Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC & DFSS projects
* Experience in leading and facilitating global teams in RCA and sustaining improvements
* Sustainable implementation of standardized best practices globally
* Built a continuous improvement culture and employee engagement in improvement activities

**Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking - Ability to understand how different parts of the organization fit together and plan long-term, align team goals with organizational objectives, anticipate risks and opportunities
* Decision-Making Makes informed, timely decisions; uses data, experience, and judgment; balances speed with accuracy
* Communication Skills- Clear, concise, and impactful communication; active listening; ability to work with stakeholders
* People Management & Talent Development - Coaching and mentoring team members, building effective teams, Delegation and empowerment
* Accountability & Ownership - Takes responsibility for outcomes, manages execution and results, holds others accountable constructively
* Stakeholder Management- Builds effective internal and external relationships, manages expectations across levels, Influences without authority
* Improvement in quality KPIs and customer satisfaction metrics
* Reduction of non-conformance, defects, warranty claims, and cost of poor quality
* Increased effectiveness and closure rate of improvement initiatives
* Enhanced value chain performance through cross-functional collaboration

**What We Offer**
This position offers a unique opportunity to support and improve quality performance across the value chain, delivering measurable business impact through continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives. As part of Vestas Quality, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and advancing a culture of data-driven problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration, and sustainable quality enhancement.
  
  
We offer an exciting and challenging role with many opportunities for both professional and personal development within an inspiring, collaborative, and productive work environment. At Vestas, we highly value initiative, accountability, and the ability to balance innovation with quality to deliver robust and sustainable solutions.
  
  
As a member of our leadership team, you will have the opportunity to help define strategic quality priorities, collaborate with diverse global stakeholders, and implement transformational improvements across the business. Demonstrating motivation, leadership capability, and solid performance will provide significant opportunities to further build and advance your career within Vestas.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Your primary workplace will be in Chennai, India.
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 31st October 2026.
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Downstream Process Excellence Lead
description:
**Where you fit in**
If you like transforming and impacting the business and the process, with a passion for accounting, reporting and analysis and innovation, this could be your chance to make your mark in the energy industry. You will grow in a supportive team that champions process custodianship, improvement and transformation, projects and portfolio management and product ownership, in support of R&A’s aspiration of becoming an Accounting and Insights Powerhouse.
  
  

* The Downstream Reporting & Analysis (R&A) Organisation is a team of >900 colleagues providing accurate, timely and insightful finance and accounting and analysis to deliver more and cleaner energy solutions.
* Within the Downstream Reporting & Analysis is the Process Excellence Team which is responsible for leading and guarding the process, covering Planning and Appraisal (PAR), Finance Accounting and Controlling (FAC), and Period End (PE), for different Classes of Business (COB) (namely Mobility, Lubricants, Low Carbon Solution, Products and Chemicals).
* This role will report to the global Downstream Process Excellence Manager and is directly responsible for projects delivery, working closely through cross-horizontal collaboration and integration with the R&A Downstream Operations Teams – Controllers and PAR, Process Owners Team, MI Centre of Excellence (COE), Finance in the Business (FitB), Process Digital Interface and other teams within Shell.

**What’s the role?**

* The DS Process Excellence Lead is responsible for leading the delivery of Efficiency, Effectiveness, Finance Digital Core, and/or Governance portfolio of projects, leading various Operations Teams towards realizing efficiency opportunities and/or strengthening process effectiveness and governance.
* Manage initiatives, covering from ideation and opportunity building, demand management, design and build, implementation/delivery, go-live, to hyper-care:
* Specific projects and initiatives may fall and/or overlap within the functions of planning and appraisal, financial accounting and controlling, financial closing/period-end activities.
* Specific projects and initiatives may be standalone projects directly local to Downstream, or as part of a portfolio/program mandated by Group due to data, systems, and/or business changes (as in the case of growth investments and divestments).
* Specific projects and initiatives may lead and managed as part of the direct scope of Process Excellence, and/or as a portfolio/program managed in collaboration with R&A Operations Teams, MI COE, Finance in the Business, other PE teams within and beyond R&A, etc.
* Lead the change management, readiness (people, process, and/or systems, as applicable) and delivery reporting requirements of the projects and initiatives, to ensure optimal visibility, timely senior sponsorship and support, sufficient insights at decision review boards (DRB) as required, as well as appropriate resourcing and capabilities, among others, from ideation to hyper-care and stabilization.
* Lead the project requirements profiling, business and process impact assessments, and risk management assessments, and subsequently communicate such to proper levels of sponsorships and stakeholders.
* Identify and execute pivotal projects that enhance effectiveness and efficiency through collaborative efforts with PAR, and Solution (MI COE, IT, etc.) teams.
* Serve as the custodian of existing processes, seeking opportunities to optimize them with streamlined interfaces and structures while mitigating risks.
* Conduct comprehensive impact assessments of changes affecting the process, align with key stakeholders on potential impacts, and meticulously document the outcomes.
* Adhere to the Demand Management model in the acceptance and prioritization of new demands.
* Understand the implications of system transitions (CFIN, S4, NUCLEUS, etc.) on the R&A DS process, engage with Operations and Implementation teams at appropriate intervals, and ensure proper traction on key risks through collaborative efforts with all relevant stakeholders.
* Assess the prospective alterations to the PAR processes resulting from corporate reorganization, mergers, divestments, and integrations.
* Ensure the compliance to standard project management model in the execution and implementation of the key projects and initiatives.
* Exemplify leadership in driving transformative changes by leveraging robust Processes, People, and Systems.
* Augment the PE reputation by adhering to standardized procedures and ensuring effective communication with broader teams.
* Shall serve as pathfinder in data and knowledge management building specifically for value stream mappings, process documentation and socialization, among other knowledge management requirements.

**What we need from you?**

* You will inspire people to make changes that will have a direct impact on our success. Furthermore, you will have:
* Master’s degree or Professional Qualification, in Business/Accounting/Finance with exceptional numeracy skills and experience.
* Excellent project or program management skills and experience to Create Value.
* Change management expertise and experience in a multi-project or portfolio level.
* Excellent oral and written presentation skills.
* Appreciation and understanding of Downstream Financial and Management Information Systems and Data Flows, as well as a passion for leveraging technology and automation.
* Passion for the Downstream Business, the Energy Transition, Powering Progress, and a curiosity for how the business delivers value.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Lead end-to-end CCaaS and Customer Service AI transformation programs that align with client vision and business objectives—enhancing contact center capabilities with cloud-native platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Five9), conversational AI, CX insights, and operating model redesign. Serve as both growth driver and delivery anchor, working with C‑suite stakeholders, platform partners, and internal teams to deliver measurable impact.

* Identify value levers across cost reduction, experience improvement, and automation.

* Drive adoption of conversational AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance service quality and efficiency.

* Communicate complex transformation initiatives clearly to executive audiences.
* Identify and cultivate follow-on opportunities within existing accounts.

**Market & Technology Insight**

* Monitor emerging CCaaS, conversational AI, and CX trends to inform strategy and innovation.
* Team Leadership
* Build, mentor, and lead cross-functional consulting teams and delivery teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Agile delivery and on‑shore/off‑shore team coordination.
* Strong stakeholder management across client and vendor teams.
* Conversational AI experience (bots, IVA, NLP) and platform migration expertise.
* Data compliance knowledge (PCI/PII, GDPR) tied to CCaaS and compliance platforms.

* Expand practice pipeline through partner GTM initiatives and follow-on client engagements.

* Have experience designing or implementing integrations between contact center platforms and enterprise CRM solutions such as Salesforce Service Cloud and Microsoft Dynamics 365.

**What We Look For**

* Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale CCaaS transformations across discovery, migration, and managed operations.
* Experience in proposal writing, executive presentations, and business development within service operations or contact center technology.
* Hands-on knowledge of CCaaS platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Five9) and integrations with CRM systems.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

title: HSE Manager
description:
Rotork is a market-leading global provider of mission-critical flow control and instrumentation solutions. Customers rely on Rotork for innovative, high quality and dependable solutions for managing the flow of liquids, gases and powders. Rotork helps customers around the world to improve efficiency, reduce emissions, minimise their environmental impact and assure safety.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Job:**

* To be the driving force in implementing a zero-accident safety culture and continuous improvement.
* Drive a strong safety culture, regulatory compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement.
* To maintain 3rd party accreditation to ISO45001
* To fully satisfy customer requirements through the establishment of robust processes and procedures within the ISO45001 H&S management system.

**Key Responsibilities and Outcomes:**

* Develop and implement HSE strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Lead safety culture transformation and behavioural safety programs.
* Act as the HSE subject matter expert for all India operations.
* Provide regular HSE performance updates to senior leadership
* Responsible for Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) compliance and performance across 3 manufacturing sites in India.
* Provide HSE support and governance for field service activities across India.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Indian regulations, including:
* Factories Act
* State Factory Rules
* Environmental regulations
* Fire and Safety requirements
* Hazardous Waste Management Rules
* Contractor Safety Regulations

Liaise with government authorities and regulatory agencies. Lead internal and external compliance audits.
  
  
**Risk Management**

* Conduct site risk assessments and hazard identification programs.
* Drive implementation of risk mitigation actions.
* Ensure safe systems of work, permit-to-work, LOTO, confined space, working at height, and contractor safety programs are effective

Incident Management
  
  

* Lead investigation of incidents, near misses, and environmental events.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Monitor incident trends and establish preventive measures.

Environmental & Sustainability Management
  
  

* Ensure environmental compliance and permit adherence.
* Drive waste reduction, energy conservation, and sustainability initiatives.
* Monitor environmental KPIs and compliance reporting.

Service Operations Safety
  
  

* Develop and implement HSE requirements for service engineers operating across India.
* Ensure travel, customer-site, and field service risks are assessed and controlled.
* Support customer audits and service-related safety requirements.

Training & Competency Development
  
  

* Develop HSE training matrix for employees and contractors.
* Deliver leadership safety training and awareness programs.
* Ensure competency assessments and certification requirements are maintained.

Emergency Preparedness
  
  

* Establish and maintain emergency response plans for all sites.
* Conduct emergency drills and business continuity exercises.
* Coordinate with local emergency services and authorities.

Management Systems
  
  

* Maintain and improve ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems (IMS).
* Lead certification audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure KPI tracking, reporting, and corrective action closure.

Contractor Management
  
  

* Implement contractor qualification and safety management programs.
* Conduct contractor safety audits and performance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with company and legal HSE requirements

**Qualifications**
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
* NEBOSH Certificate in OH&S - Preferred
* Experience in a manufacturing and site services environment
* Able to travel as and when required in around India
* 15+ years of HSE experience in manufacturing and engineering operations.
* Experience managing multi-site manufacturing facilities & handling service team and customer visits

**Desirable**

* Diploma / Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety preferred
* NEBOSH Diploma in OH&S

**Personal Specification:**
**Essential**

* Approachable personality able to motivate and influence people at all levels
* Ability to work as part of a team but also able to work alone
* Ability to manage several projects at the same time
* Good attention to detail
* Methodical approach to working
* Good Written and Oral communication skills.

title: Office & Community Manager
description:
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
  
  
Share
  
  
**About Zuora**
At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
  
  
We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
The Office & Community Manager will own the day-to-day workplace experience for Zuora’s Chennai office, creating a safe, efficient, welcoming, and well-maintained environment where employees and visitors can do their best work. Reporting to the APAC Workplace Manager, this role will connect facilities operations, vendors, budgets, employee programs, and community-building initiatives into one reliable workplace experience.
  
  
In the first 12–18 months, you will establish strong operating rhythms for the Chennai office, strengthen vendor and financial controls, improve workplace services, and help build an engaging office community aligned with regional workplace standards and business priorities.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Workplace Experience & Operations
  
  

* Own daily workplace operations and ensure the office is safe, clean, functional, and ready for employees and visitors.
* Oversee housekeeping, pantry, reception, security, maintenance, access control, transport, and related workplace services.
* Conduct regular workplace inspections and coordinate timely resolution of facilities issues, maintenance requirements, and employee concerns.
* Partner with the landlord, building management, service providers, and internal teams to maintain uninterrupted office operations.
* Establish and maintain workplace procedures, service standards, records, checklists, and operating routines.

Vendor & Financial Management
  
  

* Manage workplace vendors across sourcing support, quotations, negotiations, contracts, SLAs, AMCs, service reviews, and performance improvement.
* Monitor service quality, vendor compliance, invoices, purchase orders, and timely payments in partnership with Finance and Procurement.
* Support annual budgeting, expense tracking, forecasting, reporting, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and operational efficiency while protecting the employee experience.
* Maintain accurate records for contracts, assets, invoices, purchase orders, and workplace expenditure.

Employee Experience & Community Engagement
  
  

* Plan and deliver employee engagement activities, celebrations, wellness initiatives, and community-building programs.
* Create inclusive programs that encourage connection, collaboration, and a positive office culture.
* Gather employee feedback and translate insights into improvements to workplace services and the office experience.
* Manage workplace communications related to events, facilities updates, office guidelines, and employee initiatives.
* Support initiatives that encourage meaningful office connection, collaboration, and a strong sense of community.

Events, Hospitality & Leadership Support
  
  

* Coordinate workplace logistics for leadership visits, town halls, business meetings, team events, and external visitors.
* Manage event planning across budgets, venues, catering, vendors, employee communications, and on-site execution.
* Ensure meeting rooms, visitor areas, and office facilities are prepared to the required standard.
* Deliver a professional, inclusive, and welcoming hospitality experience for employees, leaders, and guests.

Health, Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with applicable workplace, building, fire safety, environmental, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate workplace risk assessments, safety inspections, emergency drills, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
* Maintain emergency response procedures, incident records, safety documentation, and business continuity plans.
* Work with building management, security, vendors, and internal teams to address workplace risks promptly.
* Promote a culture of safety, inclusion, accessibility, and responsible workplace practices.

Space, Assets & Workplace Projects
  
  

* Maintain accurate records of office assets, equipment, inventory, seating, and space utilization.
* Coordinate workplace requirements for employee onboarding and offboarding, including access, seating, assets, and relevant handovers.
* Support office moves, seating changes, maintenance projects, renovations, and workplace improvement initiatives.
* Monitor office utilization and identify opportunities to improve space planning and resource allocation.
* Partner with IT and other teams to ensure workplace readiness for new employees and changing business needs.

Sustainability & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support initiatives related to energy efficiency, waste reduction, responsible purchasing, and sustainable workplace operations.
* Monitor workplace feedback, service levels, vendor performance, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare periodic reports on workplace expenditure, vendor performance, employee engagement, and operational issues.
* Share updates, risks, and recommendations with the APAC Workplace Manager and escalate issues requiring regional support.

**About You**
You may be a great fit if you:
  
  

* Bring typically 6–8 years of experience in workplace operations, facilities management, corporate office administration, hospitality, or employee experience.
* Have experience managing office services, vendors, budgets, events, workplace projects, and compliance requirements.
* Can take ownership of local workplace operations, prioritize competing needs, and respond thoughtfully to time-sensitive issues.
* Build trusted relationships with employees, leaders, vendors, landlords, and cross-functional partners.
* Use sound judgment, organized processes, and practical problem-solving to improve service delivery.
* Understand financial operations such as invoice validation, purchase orders, expense tracking, budget monitoring, and vendor cost control.
* Communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different stakeholders and situations.
* Are comfortable working independently while staying connected to regional standards, priorities, and support networks.
* Use Microsoft Office or Google Workspace confidently and can learn procurement, ticketing, or facilities management systems.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in a technology, SaaS, or multinational corporate environment.
* Experience supporting office moves, renovations, space planning, or workplace improvement projects.
* Familiarity with sustainability, environmental health and safety, business continuity, or accessibility programs.
* Experience creating employee engagement or community-building programs.

**About The Team**
The Chennai Office & Community Manager is part of Zuora’s APAC Workplace team and reports to the APAC Workplace Manager. The team is responsible for creating safe, effective, and engaging workplaces that support employees, leaders, and business operations across the region.
  
  
You will work closely with HR, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, business leaders, landlords, building management, and workplace service providers. This is a hands-on role with meaningful local ownership, regional collaboration, and opportunities to expand your scope through workplace projects, employee programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
  
  

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
* Medical Insurance
* Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
* Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
* Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
* Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
* Mental wellbeing resources and support
* Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora
  
  
ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
  
  

* Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
* Learn constantly and iterate often
* Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you.
  
  
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.
  
  
Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to
**assistance@zuora.com**

description:
**Job Summary**
Consulting Manager role in a global organization responsible for driving strategic transformation and operational excellence for property and casualty insurance clients. The individual will plan and deliver complex consulting engagements mentor teams and apply deep domain expertise to improve underwriting claims policy administration and customer experience across hybrid work model and day shift assignments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end consulting engagements for property and casualty insurance clients by defining scope objectives and measurable outcomes that improve underwriting policy administration claims processing and customer service efficiency in alignment with client strategy and company goals.
* Guide clients through current state assessment of property and casualty operations by analyzing workflows systems data quality and control frameworks to identify transformation opportunities that reduce loss ratios enhance risk selection and streamline regulatory compliance.

* Coordinate day to day consulting delivery activities in a hybrid work environment by planning sprints allocating tasks tracking progress and ensuring timely stakeholder communication so that projects remain on schedule and within budgets for all assigned engagements.
* Collaborate closely with underwriting and claims teams of client organizations to translate business challenges into structured consulting initiatives that improve case triage fraud detection subrogation recovery and claims settlement accuracy using data driven insights and pragmatic process changes.
* Create clear and compelling consulting artifacts including diagnostic reports business requirement documents journey maps and executive ready presentations that explain complex property and casualty concepts in practical language for business and technology stakeholders.
* Apply advanced analytical methods to policy and claims data by identifying trends leakage drivers and portfolio performance issues so that clients can refine rating strategies improve reinsurance decisions and enhance overall profitability while maintaining regulatory and ethical standards.
* Coordinate with technology implementation teams to ensure consulting recommendations for property and casualty platforms such as policy administration and claims solutions are realistically actionable and properly sequenced enabling smooth handover from advisory phase to execution.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives within the consulting practice by documenting lessons learned from each engagement standardizing best practices for property and casualty projects and contributing to reusable frameworks and accelerators that enhance delivery quality across the organization.
* Engage proactively with client senior stakeholders during day shift meetings to clarify expectations present progress updates manage dependencies and resolve issues in a structured manner to maintain high satisfaction and build long term advisory relationships without requiring frequent travel.
* Mentor junior consultants and business analysts by providing domain guidance on property and casualty insurance concepts reviewing deliverables and encouraging rigorous problem solving approaches that uphold consulting standards and strengthen the capability of the broader team.
* Contribute to business development efforts by preparing proposals effort estimates and value narratives for property and casualty consulting opportunities highlighting the organization capability to improve operational resilience customer trust and market competitiveness for prospective clients.
* Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management requirements by embedding regulatory considerations and ethical practices into consulting recommendations thereby supporting safe innovation that protects policyholders aligns with supervisory expectations and promotes sustainable business impact for society. Qualifications
* Bring proven experience in property and casualty insurance with solid exposure to underwriting policy administration and claims operations and apply this expertise to diagnose client challenges and shape targeted consulting interventions that deliver practical business value.
* Demonstrate strong consulting skills with ability to structure problems perform root cause analysis and communicate solutions clearly so that both technical and business stakeholders can act on recommendations without ambiguity in a hybrid work setting.
* Show deep familiarity with property and casualty insurance products such as commercial lines and personal lines and use this understanding to tailor process optimization and operating model designs to specific risk profiles coverage types and channel strategies.
* Exhibit proficiency in business analysis and requirements gathering by eliciting needs from client teams documenting them in a detailed yet accessible manner and validating them through structured walkthroughs that minimize rework and project risk.
* Leverage knowledge of core insurance systems including policy and claims platforms to align consulting deliverables with practical implementation constraints ensuring that proposed solutions can be integrated smoothly into existing technology environments.
* Apply analytical and data interpretation skills to evaluate portfolio performance operational metrics and customer outcomes enabling data driven decisions that enhance profitability service quality and fairness in coverage and claims handling.
* Demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities in day shift engagements by facilitating workshops leading discussions and managing expectations in a professional manner that fosters trust and collaborative problem solving.
* Possess experience in hybrid work models with proven ability to organize tasks use collaboration tools and maintain productivity and accountability across onsite and remote interactions aligning team efforts with project timelines and deliverables.
* Display familiarity with regulatory and compliance considerations in property and casualty insurance by incorporating relevant requirements into consulting advice thereby supporting clients in maintaining robust governance and responsible market conduct.
* Show capability to guide and coach consulting colleagues by sharing domain insights reviewing outputs and providing structured feedback that raises the overall quality of client deliverables and contributes to the maturity of the consulting practice.
* Exhibit adaptability to changing client priorities and evolving insurance market conditions by regularly updating domain knowledge tracking industry trends and reflecting these insights in consulting approaches for greater relevance and impact.
* Demonstrate time management and organizational discipline appropriate for mid senior consulting positions with eight to ten years of experience by balancing multiple engagements meeting deadlines and maintaining documentation quality across the consulting lifecycle.

title: Interface Manager
description:

The Interface Manager is responsible for planning, managing, and coordinating all interface activities between the Contractor, Subcontractors, Interfacing Contractors, Primary Contractor, Utility Agencies, Statutory Authorities, Consultants, and the Engineer.
  
  
The role ensures timely information exchange, design alignment, construction synchronization, and risk?free integration across all phases—design, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
****B. Information Exchange & Documentation Control****
****C. Stakeholder Meetings & Liaison****
****D. Issue Resolution & Governance****
****3. Design Interface Responsibilities****
****4. Construction Interface Responsibilities****
****5. Testing, Commissioning & Handover****
****6. Leadership & Team Management****
****7. Compliance, Contractual & System Requirements****
****8. Qualifications & Experience****
****9. Technical & Behavioral Competencies****
****Technical Skills****

* Key ResponsibilitiesA. Interface Management & Coordination

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**Physical/Mental Requirements**
Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.
  
  
**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**
Occasional travel up to 20%
  
  
Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.
  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.
  
  
Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.
  
  
External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.
  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED
  
  
Financial Accountability**
Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
  
  
**Supervision**
Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.
  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
  
  
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
  
  
To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Commercial Manager, Life of Mine Solutions
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future?
  
  
We believe we can develop the technology and gain the know-how to make a difference. It’s a big responsibility, and we are committed to making an impactful positive change. We need your skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials and technology needed for a better future.
  
  
**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring**

* Outcome-based models: Build and price lifecycle agreements cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, performance bonus and penalty structures, availability and throughput commitments.
* Indexing & term: Set multi-year index mechanics and term structures that protect FLS margin without. Define what good looks like before we commit externally.
* Consignment & ownership: Structure equipment ownership, consignment parts, and inventory models that the customer and FLS can both stand behind.
* Go/no-go discipline: Apply a clear deal evaluation framework. To advise whether we walk away from deals we cannot deliver or cannot price with confidence.

**Bid, Negotiation & Contract**

* Commercial offers: Lead the build of commercial proposals and pricing. Make sure pricing transparency, KPI definitions, and wear thresholds are defined and defensible, not left open.
* Negotiation: Run commercial negotiation with the customer, holding the line on the points that carry real risk and conceding where it does not.
* Contract integrity: Work with legal to close performance language gaps, per-KPI cap contradictions, and definition risk before signature, not after a dispute.
* One FLS: Make sure product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution are aligned on the commitment before it goes to the customer.

**Execution Readiness & Delivery Alignment**

* Operational truth: Logically test every commercial model against operational reality. A model that ignores site conditions is a future loss.
* Handover: Hand agreements to the delivery teams with the commercial logic, obligations, and risk points named clearly. Nothing implied.
* Performance tracking: Define how each agreement's performance should be measured and reported, so bonus / penalty mechanics for example are based on agreed data, not argument.

**Pipeline, Reporting & Governance**

* Support and maintain a structured commercial pipeline from opportunity through to signed agreement, with clear ownership at each stage for the sales regions you are working with
* Report deal status, margin, and commercial risk to leadership with the call a action and owner named, not just an observation.
* Maintain commercial templates and pricing tools so the team works from a consistent, disciplined base.

**Commercial Tools, Estimating & Standards**

* Commercial tooling: Support the development and ongoing improvement of the commercial tools the team relies on pricing models, offer templates, deal evaluation and go / no-go frameworks. Keep them practical and used, not shelfware.
* Estimating tools: Support the build and maintenance of estimating tools and cost models, Maintenance reference documents so estimators price lifecycle scope from a consistent, defensible base and the assumptions behind a number are clear.
* Commercial & legal guidelines: Work with legal to develop and maintain commercial and legal guidelines for long-term agreements: term and indexation mechanics, KPI and wear-threshold definitions, liability and cap structures, bonus / penalty language. Give the team a clear standard to work from before negotiation, not after a dispute.
* Equipment-specific packages: Develop repeatable, equipment-specific commercial packages for the core FLS product lines, so a lifecycle offer for a given asset starts from a proven template rather than a blank page.
* Version control & ownership: Own version control on tools, templates, and guidelines so the team works from one current source, with changes named and dated.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships**

* Socialize deals, strategic or commercial approach with regional leadership, sales teams, product ownership
* Engage mining operators, internal product, and regional operations to identify and qualify lifecycle opportunities worth pursuing.
* Represent FLS in commercial discussions, performance reviews, and customer planning sessions over the life of the agreement.
* Run competitive intelligence on rival lifecycle and performance-based offers to keep FLS's commercial position sharp.

**Team Support & Mentorship**

* Coach estimators GBC and commercial team members on deal structuring, pricing discipline, and the go/no-go framework.
* Build commercial capability across the team so quality does not depend on a single person.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Win rate on lifecycle deals: Percentage of qualified opportunities converted to signed agreements.
* Margin integrity: Delivered margin against committed margin across the active agreement portfolio.
* Cycle time: Average time from qualified opportunity to signed agreement.
* Execution alignment: Percentage of signed deals delivered without commercial dispute or unplanned concession.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Deep understanding of outcome-based commercial models in mining - cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, consignment, bonus/penalty mechanics.
* Strong grasp of fixed plant and lifecycle equipment economics: availability, throughput, wear life, repair and renewal.
* Commercial negotiation and contract construction, including working with legal on performance language and risk.
* Ability to connect commercial structure to operational delivery - commercial models built on operational truth, not optimism.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leaders and customers and holding a position under challenge.
* Strong commercial judgment and the discipline to walk away from a deal that does not hold up.
* Comfort working across product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution to deliver one FLS to the customer.

**Education & Experience**

* Work experience: Minimum 10 years in mining, industrial services, or capital equipment, with a strong record in commercial deal structuring and negotiation.
* Demonstrated experience building and closing multi-year, outcome-based or performance contracts with measurable commercial results.
* Experience leading and developing commercial team members, including geographically dispersed teams.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Special Requirements**

* Ability to travel approximately 30 percent of the time, including internationally to mine sites and customer locations.
* Valid driver's license and passport.

**Core Competencies**

* Business acumen: Clear grasp of mining industry trends, risk, and market dynamics that drive FLS's lifecycle business internationally.
* Drive for results: Takes accountability for the commercial outcome and success of the deals owned.
* Influence and persuade: Convinces customers and internal stakeholders to align on a course of action; holds a position when challenged.
* Decision making: Takes personal responsibility for commercial decisions and their impact, including when data is incomplete.
* Critical thinking: Structured analysis of commercial and operational risk to reach a defensible position.
* Continuous improvement: Challenges current commercial process to sharpen FLS's lifecycle position.
* Mentor and coach: Build commercial capability in others through direct, supportive feedback.
* Think strategically: Connects individual deals to the broader shift from product selling to lifecycle accountability.

title: Multi-Store Manager – QSR Operations
description:
**Multi-Store Manager – Retail Operations**
**Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream**

***Chennai / Bangalore***

***Running one store well is a skill. Running several — without losing your grip on any of them — is something else entirely. That's the person we're looking for.***

**About Us**

Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream has been one of South India's most loved artisanal ice cream brands since 2011. We operate across Chennai and Bangalore, with an active expansion underway. As we scale, we need a sharp, grounded operations leader who can hold our stores to a high standard — and build the systems that make that standard self-sustaining.

**The Role**

As Multi-Store Manager, you will have end-to-end accountability for a cluster of Amadora stores. This is not a desk job.
***You'll be on the floor, in the numbers, and in the conversation — every day.***

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

**Operations & Standards**

* Own daily operations across your cluster of stores — opening/closing compliance, staffing, service flow, and cleanliness
* Conduct structured store visits with written observations and follow-through
* Ensure product quality and presentation standards are consistent across every outlet
* Identify and fix operational breakdowns before they become habits

**People & Performance**

* Hire, onboard, coach, and where necessary, exit store-level staff
* Build a culture of accountability — shift leads and store managers should run their stores, not wait for you to run it for them
* Conduct regular performance reviews and create development plans for high-potential team members
* Reduce attrition by building teams that actually want to stay

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Track daily sales, waste, and cost metrics across your cluster
* Flag variances and drive corrective action with urgency
* Manage petty cash, vendor coordination, and inventory discipline at the store level
* Own your cluster's P&L contribution — you'll know your numbers cold

**Customer Experience & Brand**

* Monitor customer feedback across Google Reviews, Swiggy, Zomato, and in-store
* Ensure complaints are resolved quickly and learnings are fed back into operations
* Maintain Amadora's reputation as a premium, detail-obsessed brand at every touchpoint

**Reporting & Communication**

* Report daily to senior leadership with structured updates — not just "all okay"
* Surface issues early, propose solutions, and follow through on commitments
* Be the connective tissue between the ground and the leadership team

**What We're Looking For**

* 5–8 years in F&B, QSR, or specialty retail operations — with at least 2–3 years managing multiple locations
* A natural operator: you notice what's off before anyone tells you
* Strong people instincts — firm when needed, fair always
* Comfortable with numbers: sales, waste, cost per unit, variance — this should be your language
* Excellent communicator — clear in writing, direct in person
* Chennai or Bangalore based; willingness to travel between cities as needed
* Experience with delivery platforms (Swiggy/Zomato) and basic POS systems is a plus

**Why Amadora?**

We're not a cookie-cutter QSR chain. Every scoop we serve is made from scratch using real ingredients — no shortcuts, no compromise. That means the person leading our stores needs to genuinely care about quality, not just throughput.

***This role has real influence***
.

You'll shape how dozens of people show up to work, how thousands of customers experience our brand, and how we grow into new markets.

***If you want a role where your fingerprints are on the operation — this is it.***

title: AVP Card operations
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
The role provides essential operational control across third-party management, stock and order administration, vendor financial management, product-change testing, and day-to-day embossing support. Without a backfill, these responsibilities would need to be redistributed across existing team members, increasing operational risk, reducing capacity, and potentially affecting service quality and control effectiveness.
  
  
The role acts as the key coordination point between HSBC stakeholders and the external vendor, supporting the continued delivery of card-related operations and daily operational support for embossing related activities.
  
  
The position also supports Third Party Engagement Manager (TPEM) activities and manages actions within Archer for third-party management activities.
  
  
**Key Activities Managed**
**Third-party and vendor governance**

* Manage TPEM and vendor governance activities.
* Maintain and update activities within Archer, including taking appropriate action against assigned controls.
* Track governance requirements, actions, risks, issues and evidence.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and the vendor to ensure obligations are completed on time.

**Stakeholder and vendor coordination**

* Act as the single point of contact between HSBC stakeholders and the vendor.
* Coordinate business requirements, operational changes, and service requests.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely communication across relevant teams.
* Facilitate effective collaboration between business, operations, technology, procurement, and vendor contacts.

**Plastics and collateral order management**

* Manage orders for card plastics and collateral.
* Track stock levels, movements, consumption, and replenishment requirements.
* Identify potential shortages, excess stock, or supply issues and take preventative action.
* Maintain accurate records and provide status updates to stakeholders.

**Forecasting and vendor cost management**

* Monitor vendor costs against agreed requirements and forecasts.
* Track vendor invoices and payouts.
* Investigate discrepancies and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders.

**Testing and product-change support**

* Provide ad hoc testing support for changes to card plastics and collateral.
* Coordinate with Idemia on revisions, new developments and product changes relating to credit and debit cards.
* Support test planning, execution, defect follow-up, and sign-off activities.
* Ensure operational impacts are understood before changes are introduced.

**Embossing operations and team management**

* Manage a team responsible for embossing-related activities.
* Oversee daily file processing and ensure queries are addressed promptly.
* Manage complaints, escalations, and exceptions through to resolution.
* Monitor team workload, service quality, and operational performance.
* Periodic review of procedures, controls and service expectations are consistently followed.

**Criticality of the Role**
**Required**
The role supports activities that directly affect the availability, accuracy and timely delivery of card products and related collateral. Effective management is required to:
  
  

* Maintain continuity of daily embossing and card-processing activities.
* Prevent stock shortages that could disrupt card issuance or replacement processes.
* Ensure vendor controls and governance obligations are completed.
* Protect financial accuracy through effective cost and payout tracking.
* Support timely implementation of card-product changes.
* Ensure queries, complaints and operational escalations are resolved within expected timescales.
* Maintain clear accountability between HSBC and the vendor.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate or above in any discipline with 10-12 years’ experience
* Person having experience and comprehensive knowledge on credit card operations is preferred.
* Strong analytical ability, logical thinking, and risk awareness.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Have a strong team spirit and ability to work under pressure.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India
