title: CMS Manager
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
The CMS Manager oversees day-to-day content operations across assigned business areas, ensuring digital content is implemented accurately, efficiently, and in line with business priorities. The role manages operational delivery across cross-functional partners and translates requirements into clear plans that balance deadlines, available capacity, technical requirements, and quality standards. A key part of the role is providing clear ownership and direction for CMS operations, particularly those delivered through WordPress.
  
  
The role combines team leadership with strong working knowledge of content management systems, especially WordPress, alongside operational workflows, quality assurance, and continuous improvement. The CMS Manager is expected to identify risks early, support the resolution of complex implementation issues, develop team capability, and improve the processes and tools used to manage content at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Operational Planning & Delivery****

* Oversee delivery across assigned business areas, including CMS and WordPress activity, aligning execution with business priorities, deadlines, and quality expectations.
* Assess incoming demand against available capacity, prioritize work, and identify risks or dependencies that could affect delivery.
* Coordinate complex updates, launches, migrations, and recurring operational workflows within WordPress and other relevant systems, ensuring work progresses through the appropriate review and approval stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for partners across Editorial, SEO, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Compliance, Product, and Engineering, as relevant to assigned areas.

****CMS/Wordpress Expertise****

* Maintain strong practical knowledge of WordPress and related content management tools, templates, plugins, components, and workflows, providing guidance to the team where required.
* Oversee the effective use of WordPress across assigned business areas, ensuring agreed approaches, standards, and publishing practices are followed consistently.
* Support the team in troubleshooting complex CMS and WordPress implementation issues, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with relevant technical partners.
* Identify recurring defects, manual tasks, and operational risks within CMS workflows, and recommend scalable improvements to tools, processes, and controls.

****Team Leadership & Development****

* Lead and support team members responsible for CMS operations, providing clear direction, coaching, feedback, and performance guidance.
* Develop team skills in CMS and WordPress usage, quality assurance, troubleshooting, operational judgement, and independent problem solving.
* Conduct regular check-ins and performance discussions, set clear expectations, and support individual development.

****Syndication Management****

* Own the CMS implementation and publishing workflow for syndicated content across external platforms.
* Ensure syndicated content meets platform specific formatting, building, and quality guidelines.
* Coordinate with the Operations team to maintain content continuity and manage daily and weekly content calendars.
* Monitor syndication quality and resolve publishing issues to ensure accurate and timely delivery.

****Quality Assurance & Standards****

* Ensure content and page implementations in WordPress and other relevant systems meet agreed standards for accuracy, structure, configuration, SEO requirements, monetisation elements, and applicable editorial and compliance guidelines.
* Maintain effective quality checks, analyze error patterns, and implement corrective actions to reduce defects and rework.

****Reporting & Continuous Improvement****

* Maintain operational reporting for assigned areas, including throughput, turnaround times, revisions, quality, and capacity.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve delivery.
* Share concise updates on progress, risks, and improvement opportunities with relevant leaders.

**Skills & Experience**

* 8 – 10 years of full-time experience
* 2-3 years of experience in leading and managing a team
* Experience managing a team, including workload planning, coaching, performance feedback, and accountability for delivery and quality.
* Experience managing CMS operations, digital content implementation, content production, or digital operations in a high-volume environment, with responsibility for delivery through WordPress or a comparable platform.
* Strong practical knowledge of WordPress, including page components, templates, plugins, workflows, and configuration. Experience with AEM or another comparable content management system is beneficial.
* Ability to plan multiple workstreams, manage dependencies, and adjust priorities as business needs change.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements and constructively address infeasible requests.
* Demonstrated ability to lead the resolution of operational, WordPress, or wider CMS issues and identify practical, repeatable solutions.
* High attention to detail, sound organizational skills, and the ability to balance quality, timeliness, and changing priorities.

**Perks**

* Day off on the 3rd Friday of every month (one long weekend each month)
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Program to promote health well-being
* Monthly Office Commutation Reimbursement Program
* Paid paternity and maternity leaves

title: Coach Manager - Online Chess Learning
description:
**Company Description**
Chennai Chess Club is India’s fastest-growing chess community, dedicated to delivering high-quality chess education to learners around the world. The club offers structured online and in-person programs, complemented by engaging meetups and events across Chennai. With over 2000 students globally, Chennai Chess Club provides a vibrant environment for both aspiring and experienced players. The organization is focused on building a strong, inclusive chess culture and creating opportunities for continuous learning and competition.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Coach Manager to oversee the end-to-end lifecycle, performance, and operational excellence of our global Chess Coach network.

Sitting at the intersection of Talent Operations, Instructional Quality, and Community Building, you will scale our chess coaching ecosystem. You will be responsible for upholding high pedagogical standards, driving coach engagement and retention, optimizing coach capacity across batches, and ensuring exceptional learning outcomes for our students.

This role requires a deep background in chess instruction—whether as a player, certified coach, or academy operator—combined with strong operational discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Coach Lifecycle & Talent Development**

* Lead recruitment and technical evaluation processes to source high-caliber chess coaches (FIDE-rated / titled players preferred).
* Design and execute structured onboarding and induction programs covering our platform, curriculum, and teaching methodology.
* Drive continuous upskilling initiatives on chess pedagogy, interactive tool usage, and student engagement strategies.
* Build sustainable talent pipelines and retention initiatives for top-performing coaches.

**2. Performance Management & Quality Assurance**

* Establish clear delivery standards and evaluate coaching performance through regular session audits.
* Monitor key quality metrics (student retention, session ratings, student progress) and implement targeted improvement plans (PIPs) where needed.
* Refine matching criteria to align student rating tiers, learning goals, and age groups with the right coach expertise.

**3. Academic Quality & Instructional Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for complex chess domain questions, curriculum clarification, and delivery challenges.
* Collect frontline feedback from coaches to collaborate with Curriculum and Student Operations teams on improving learning materials and class tools.
* Track student rating progressions and batch health metrics to ensure strong academic results.

**4. Operations & Workforce Planning**

* Manage student-coach allocation, schedule adjustments, and batch health across international time zones.
* Forecast coach capacity requirements to support new cohort launches and category expansions.
* Oversee operational delivery to ensure seamless class scheduling and zero coverage gaps.

**5. Compensation & Financial Operations**

* Oversee wage administration, payout tracking, and dispute resolution in partnership with Finance.
* Manage performance-linked bonus programs, incentive structures, and career growth levels for coaches.
* Optimize coach capacity and payout structures to balance network growth with unit economics.

**6. Coach Experience & Engagement**

* Cultivate an active community culture among chess coaches through webinars, peer analysis sessions, and recognition programs.
* Act as an advocate for coaches, managing grievances and maintaining high morale across a distributed network.
* Track engagement metrics (eNPS) to build a collaborative, high-retention environment.

**Role Requirements**

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* Chess Experience: Proven background as an active/former chess coach, titled player (e.g., CM, FM, IM, GM), or certified FIDE Instructor / Trainer.
* Network Operations: Experience managing chess coaches or running/operating a chess academy, club, or EdTech vertical.

**Key Competencies**

* 3–6 years of experience in Coach Operations, Academic Management, or Community Operations.
* Strong grasp of chess training methodologies across beginner, intermediate, and advanced student levels.
* Data-driven approach to tracking operational metrics (retention, utilization, student feedback).
* Excellent communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder alignment skills.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.
* Leadership opportunity to shape the future of digital chess education.
* Dynamic, remote-friendly workplace culture driven by a passion for chess.

description:
**Job Description: State**
**Business Head – Tamil Nadu (Residential Solar)**

**Company:**
Roofsol Homes Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Tamil Nadu

**Department:**
State Business Head

**Experience:**
10-12 Years

**Reports to:**
Chief Operating Officer, Mumbai.

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical, Mechanical, or a related Engineering discipline

**Industry:**
Solar Energy / Renewable Energy / Solar EPC

**About the Company**

Roofsol Homes Pvt. Ltd. is engaged in residential rooftop solar projects under the Government of India's PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana. The company is expanding its presence across India and is looking for an experienced, result-oriented State Head to lead its business and operations in Tamil Nadu.

**Role Overview**

The State Head will be responsible for establishing, expanding, and managing Roofsol Homes' residential rooftop solar business across Tamil Nadu. The role requires an all-round professional with strong sales and business development capabilities, distribution network expansion experience, team leadership skills, and hands-on expertise in solar project execution and operations.

The candidate will be responsible for driving business growth, building a strong local partner ecosystem, managing state-level operations, and ensuring timely and quality execution of residential solar projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Business Development**

·      Drive residential rooftop solar sales across Tamil Nadu under the PM Surya Ghar scheme.

·      Develop and execute state-level business plans to achieve sales, installation, and revenue targets.

·      Identify new business opportunities, market potential, and growth avenues across the state.

·      Build relationships with customers, channel partners, dealers, distributors, and other relevant stakeholders.

·      Monitor sales pipelines, lead conversion, market performance, and achievement of business targets.

**2. Distribution Network Development**

·      Identify, appoint, and develop channel partners, dealers, and local business associates across key districts.

·      Expand the company's market reach through an effective distribution and partner network.

·      Train, guide, and support channel partners to improve lead generation, customer conversion, and business performance.

·      Ensure regular engagement with partners and address business-related challenges.

**3. Project Execution & Operations**

·      Oversee the end-to-end execution of residential rooftop solar projects, from order confirmation and site survey to installation and commissioning.

·      Coordinate with project teams, installation vendors, procurement, logistics, and other internal departments.

·      Ensure timely material availability, installation quality, adherence to safety standards, and customer satisfaction.

·      Monitor project progress and resolve execution-related issues to minimise delays.

·      Coordinate with relevant DISCOMs and other stakeholders for required approvals, net metering, inspections, and subsidy-related processes, as applicable.

**4. Team Leadership & State Management**

·      Build, lead, and manage the state-level sales and operations team.

·      Set performance targets, review team productivity, and drive accountability for business outcomes.

·      Develop local talent and ensure effective coordination between sales, channel partners, and project execution teams.

·      Establish regular reporting, performance monitoring, and operational review mechanisms.

**5. Business Planning & Performance Monitoring**

·      Prepare state-level business plans, sales forecasts, and expansion strategies.

·      Monitor sales, order bookings, installations, project turnaround time, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

·      Track market developments, competitor activities, and government policies affecting residential solar.

·      Ensure compliance with company processes, applicable scheme guidelines, and operational standards.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

·      B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

·      10-12 years of overall professional experience, with substantial experience in the solar energy sector.

·      Strong experience in residential rooftop solar, preferably under PM Surya Ghar or similar distributed solar programmes.

·      Proven capabilities in sales, business development, channel partner management, and business expansion.

·      Practical understanding of rooftop solar project execution, installation, commissioning, and associated operational processes.

·      Experience in leading teams and managing business operations across a state or multiple districts.

·      Good understanding of local market dynamics and the solar business ecosystem in Tamil Nadu.

·      Proficiency in Tamil and English is essential; knowledge of other regional languages will be an advantage.

·      Willingness to travel extensively across Tamil Nadu.

Candidates must be based in Tamil Nadu, native in Tamil language preferably should be based in Chennai and should be capable of independently driving both business development and state-level operations.

title: Support Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Pulse Telesystems is a leading telecom solution provider in India, delivering personalized telecom services that support evolving business needs. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Chennai, the company has expanded into multiple major metropolitan cities, serving over 4,000 clients across diverse industries. Its offerings include Internet Leased Lines, VoIP Solutions, Cloud Telephony, Virtual Numbers, SIP Internet Calling, custom CRM integrations, and advanced spam monitoring and CNAM services. Pulse Telesystems is a trusted telecom partner for top enterprises such as Zoho, MGM Healthcare, Larsen & Toubro, CEAT, India Cements Ltd., and PVR Cinemas, helping them improve performance and reliability. Team members join a growing organization focused on innovation, service quality, and long-term client relationships.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, disciplined and accountable Support Shift Lead to own day-to-day support operations during an assigned shift. The person will actively monitor tickets and incidents from logging through resolution, enforce response and resolution SLAs, coordinate the team, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. This role requires a hands-on leader who follows up relentlessly, escalates risks early, maintains accurate updates, and holds the team to agreed processes and commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.  Support Ticket & Incident Ownership

●      Monitor the support queue continuously and ensure every issue has a clear owner, priority, next action and target time.

●      Track tickets end-to-end—from acknowledgement and triage to troubleshooting, resolution, validation and closure.

●      Review ageing, overdue, stalled, reopened and high-priority tickets; drive action plans to prevent avoidable delays.

●      Enforce response, update and resolution SLAs; escalate potential breaches before they occur.

●      Coordinate major incidents, ensure timely technical escalation, and maintain an accurate incident timeline and handover notes.

2.  Team Leadership & Performance

●      Allocate and rebalance work based on severity, skills, workload and urgency; confirm ownership of every active issue.

●      Run shift kick-offs, periodic queue reviews and end-of-shift handovers.

●      Set clear expectations, monitor productivity and quality, and address missed commitments promptly and fairly.

●      Coach team members on troubleshooting, ticket hygiene, customer handling and escalation discipline.

●      Identify repeated performance gaps, document facts, and raise persistent issues to the Support Manager.

3.  Proactive Communication & Stakeholder Management

●      Provide timely, concise and factual updates to customers, internal teams, management and relevant stakeholders.

●      Communicate impact, current status, actions underway, blockers, ownership and the next update time—without waiting to be chased.

●      Alert stakeholders early when an issue risks breaching SLA or affecting business operations.

●      Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, vendors and other teams until dependencies are resolved.

●      Ensure no critical issue goes silent and no shift ends without a documented handover of open risks.

4.  Process, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

●      Maintain accurate ticket records, incident notes, escalation details, workaround steps and resolution summaries.

●      Prepare shift reports covering ticket volumes, SLA performance, open/overdue incidents, major risks and follow-up owners.

●      Identify recurring incidents and recommend problem-management actions, knowledge-base updates and process improvements.

●      Follow support procedures, access controls, customer communication standards and incident-management policies.

●      Use ticketing and monitoring tools consistently; keep dashboards and operational trackers current.

Required Skills & Competencies

●      Strong ownership, urgency, discipline and follow-through; comfortable enforcing standards and holding people accountable.

●      Excellent written and verbal communication; able to provide clear updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

●      Sound incident triage, prioritisation, escalation and problem-solving skills.

●      Experience coordinating a support/helpdesk/service desk/NOC/application support team.

●      Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and confidence handling competing priorities.

●      Ability to remain calm, firm and professional during high-severity incidents or customer escalations.

●      Working knowledge of SLAs, ticket lifecycle, incident management, shift handovers and operational reporting.

Experience & Qualifications

●      Typically 3–6 years of experience in technical support, IT operations, service desk, application support or a related environment.

●      At least 1–2 years in a team-lead, shift-lead, senior support or incident-coordination capacity preferred.

●      Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.

●      Exposure to monitoring dashboards, SLA reports, escalation matrices and knowledge-base processes.

●      ITIL Foundation or equivalent incident/service-management training is an advantage.

Success Measures (KPIs)

●      SLA compliance for first response, stakeholder updates and resolution.

●      Reduction in overdue, ageing and unassigned tickets.

●      Quality and timeliness of incident communications and shift handovers.

●      Ticket documentation completeness and resolution quality.

●      Escalation timeliness, repeat-incident trends and customer/stakeholder feedback.

●      Team adherence to process, ownership and agreed action deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is firm but fair, highly visible in the support queue, and proactive by default. They do not wait for reminders, allow issues to drift, or accept vague status updates. They establish clear owners and deadlines, communicate risks early, verify that actions are completed, and maintain professional accountability without resorting to disrespectful or aggressive behaviour.

Application Note

* Applicants should highlight examples where they improved SLA performance, managed critical incidents, coordinated a support team, prevented escalations through proactive communication, or reduced ticket backlog.
* Please share the resume to hr@pulse.in/ samuel@pulse.in

title: Business Manager – Electric Motor Scrap
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Business Manager to lead the procurement and trading of electric motor scrap and associated non-ferrous metals. The ideal candidate will have a strong existing supplier network among motor recyclers, e-waste processors, and industrial scrap generators, along with a deep understanding of metal recovery economics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Sourcing & Procurement: Identify, develop, and manage a robust supply chain for electric motor scrap, including dismantled motors, armatures, and copper-bearing scrap from motor recyclers, electronics, and industrial units .
* Supplier Network Expansion: Build and strengthen relationships with scrap aggregators, motor manufacturers, and e-waste processors to ensure a consistent volume of high-grade feedstock .
* Commercial Negotiation: Evaluate scrap quality, recovery potential, and assay reports to negotiate competitive pricing and favorable payment terms .
* Market Intelligence: Monitor daily market trends, scrap pricing movements (Copper, Aluminium, Steel), and supply-demand dynamics to optimize procurement strategies .
* Logistics & Compliance: Coordinate inbound logistics and ensure all purchases comply with environmental, safety, and e-waste regulatory requirements .

**Candidate Profile:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Metallurgy, Commerce, or Supply Chain.
* Experience: Proven track record (3–10+ years) in metal scrap procurement, specifically with electric motors, ferrous/non-ferrous trading.
* Skills: Strong negotiation skills, existing supplier connections in the scrap ecosystem, and proficiency in Excel for reporting .

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to build and lead a vertical within a growing recycling business.

title: Market Risk Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
FR&Gs mission is to provide effective and efficient identification, measurement, monitoring and control of market, liquidity & Stress Testing related to the clearing and settlement processes for DTCC, its members and the markets. In addition, FR&G provides critical governance and quality assurance capabilities for key risk functions that are designed to meet rigorous organizational and regulatory standards. FR&G works under delegated authority from the Board and senior management to manage these risks within defined risk tolerances, as approved by the Board and senior management. FR&G collaborates closely with Quantitative Risk Management and the Counterparty Credit Risk teams to maintain an integrated and comprehensive approach to financial risk management at DTCC to support an effective second line of defense. FR&Gs prime directive for DTCC's applicable clearing agencies and joint ventures consists of the following:
  
  

* Maintain sufficient collateral to cover any losses associated with the liquidation of any defaulting member or family portfolio under extreme but plausible scenarios;
* Ensure that sufficient liquidity resources are available so that each entity is able to settle all transactions as contracted in the event of a failure by the single largest member or family under extreme but plausible circumstances;
* Exercise continuous improvement of policies, procedures and processes that support robust, ongoing member surveillance and effective but appropriate response to distress events; and
* Manage FR&G to maintain a deep and broad product knowledge and risk framework to effectively measure and manage market, liquidity and credit risks. Market Risk for Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (FICC) and National Securities Clearing Corporation (NSCC) is responsible for the monitoring of daily margin calculation and managing market and liquidity risk exposures arising from trade execution and settlement activities in the clearing corporations and the depository. Responsibilities also include driving new business initiatives, overseeing risk systems design and continuous enhancements, compliance with Risk Management policies and procedures. Responsible for understanding of margining methodologies, keen understanding of financial markets and client profiles, and effectively collaborate with other DTCC teams to identify, analyze, and mitigate potential risks and safeguard financial market in which DTCC plays a pivotal role.

**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
As a Director, you will provide senior leadership across Financial Risk & Governance (FR&G), supporting DTCC’s clearing agencies and critical market infrastructure. You will be accountable for the identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of market and liquidity risk exposures, operating within Board‑approved risk tolerances and regulatory expectations.
  
  
You will serve as a senior leader for the FR&G organization in Chennai, combining direct people management responsibilities with a broader leadership presence across the local Market and Liquidity Risk teams. This is a key role which strengthens DTCC’s global risk operating model, developing talent, and ensuring consistent execution and risk culture across regions.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide senior oversight of daily market and liquidity risk activities, including market risk, stress testing, liquidity sufficiency, and member exposure monitoring across DTCC clearing entities as we move toward 24x7 clearing.
* Ensure risk management practices adhere to DTCC policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations, exercising sound [LL1] judgment and timely escalation where required.
* Partner closely with Quantitative Risk Management, Counterparty Credit Risk, and Clearing & Settlement stakeholders to support a cohesive and integrated financial risk framework.
* Drive continuous improvement of risk methodologies, processes, and controls to strengthen resilience under extreme but plausible market stress scenarios.
* Support enhancements to market, liquidity, and stress testing risk systems, tools, and reporting infrastructure through collaboration with technology and other stakeholders.
* Support risk assessments related to new initiatives, products, or material changes as required, consistent with established risk frameworks and governance.
* Lead, develop, and manage Market and Liquidity Risk professionals across the regional offices, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Serve as a senior leadership presence for the FR&G regional offices, fostering engagement, coordination, and collaboration across teams, regardless of reporting alignment.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed environment, influencing stakeholders and driving outcomes across functions and regions, including in the absence of direct management authority.
* Establish strong cross-functional relationships to promote alignment, resolve competing priorities, and deliver consistent execution of risk objectives
* Provide senior leadership and serve as a central point of communication across stakeholders, providing clear, transparent, and timely updates on risk exposure, emerging issues, and strategic initiatives.
* Support responses and inquiries from internal audits, regulatory examinations, and governance reviews, including issue remediation and appropriate escalation to senior management.
* Contribute to global risk governance forums, leadership discussions, and cross‑functional initiatives to support DTCC’s broader risk management strategy and objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 10 years of related experience
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Significant experience in market risk, liquidity risk, stress testing, or financial risk management within a clearing organization, exchange, bank, or financial market infrastructure environment.
* Proven people leadership experience, including direct line management of managers and/or senior professionals.
* Demonstrated ability to provide leadership influence and coordination across teams without direct reporting relationships, particularly in regional or multi‑location environments.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, margining methodologies, liquidity risk frameworks, and regulatory expectations applicable to clearing agencies.
* Strong communication, judgment, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to operate effectively at senior leadership levels.

description:
Job title : Manager — Performance & Rewards / Compensation & Benefits

Skill : Performance Reward, Compensation & Benefits

Experience: 10 to 12 Years

Location : Chennai

Process scope

Annual increment and bonus cycle administration, budgeting and cost input consolidation, off-cycle

compensation processing, benefits and flexi administration, claims and insurance interfaces, share plan

administration support, executive compensation and NRC/ERC pack preparation, and performance cycle

system administration.

Role purpose

To own the operational delivery of the reward and benefits calendar — annual cycle administration, benefits

renewal and claims, share plan support and executive compensation packs — with the accuracy and

confidentiality the subject matter demands.

Key responsibilities

• Own the administration of the annual increment, bonus and performance review cycles: system set-up,

eligibility data, communications, letter generation and distribution to the reward calendar.

• Consolidate headcount and cost inputs for budgeting and allocate staff costs to entities and properties

within SLA.

• Manage off-cycle compensation request triage, validation of new hire packages and the accurate flow of

changes into payroll before cut-off.

• Own benefits and flexi administration — enrolment windows, renewal configuration and UAT, claims

validation and the insurance and broker interfaces.

• Ensure statutory benefit reporting obligations (including MOM/WICA submissions) are met within

mandated timelines without exception.

• Oversee share plan administration support: access provisioning, legal entity record set-up, award data

preparation and dry runs.

• Prepare executive compensation data, NRC/ERC meeting packs and disclosure inputs to the required lead

times, working under strict confidentiality.

• Own control quality across all reward transactions — maker–checker, approval evidence and reconciliation

of interface files, including alerting on missing files within the 2-hour window.

• Produce reward operations reporting and support internal and external audit of compensation and

benefits processes.

Must-have skills and experience

• 10-12 years in compensation and benefits administration or reward operations, including 2+ years leading

a team.

• Hands-on delivery of an annual increment and bonus cycle in a large organisation.

• Strong benefits administration experience including enrolment, claims and insurer or broker liaison.

• Advanced Excel — modelling, reconciliation, large data sets — and strong numerical accuracy.

• Working knowledge of Workday compensation and benefits modules.

• Demonstrated handling of highly confidential compensation data.

• Familiarity with Singapore HR and Compensation policies

Good-to-have skills and experience

• Share plan, equity or long-term incentive administration.

• Executive compensation and remuneration committee support.

• Statutory benefit reporting experience (MOM, WICA or equivalent).

• Workday Advanced Compensation configuration.

• Experience supporting reward audits or remuneration disclosures.

Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. The IT Sourcing Manager is responsible for the commercial and contractual architecture of the India sourcing project. This role acts as the vital link between Onshore Beneficiaries (Business & IT Managers) and the External Vendor Market. Your mission is to translate the technical and operational needs of our onshore stakeholders into high-quality sourcing strategies, ensuring that the vendors selected provide the exact expertise, cost-efficiency, and compliance.

* RFP & Tender Management: Lead the end-to-end Request for Proposal (RFP) process, ensuring that all technical criteria defined by onshore beneficiaries are rigorously evaluated during vendor selection.
* Sourcing Strategy: Execute sourcing decisions that balance technical excellence, cost-optimization, and long-term scalability.
* Negotiation & Contract Management
* Commercial Negotiation: Lead negotiations on pricing structures, volume discounts, and contract terms to maximize value for the Group.
* SLA & Contractual Governance: Ensure that all vendor contracts include robust Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that directly reflect the service quality expected by onshore beneficiaries.
* Contractual Compliance: Ensure all agreements strictly adhere to BNP Paribas Group procurement policies and global cybersecurity/risk standards.
* Vendor Relationship & Financial Oversight
* Vendor Lifecycle Management: Manage the formal onboarding of new partners and the strategic exit/transition of legacy providers.
* Commercial Escalation: Act as the first point of escalation for any commercial discrepancies, contract breaches, or cost-related deviations impacting the project budget.
* Cost Optimization: Partner with FinOps and Finance to monitor vendor spend and ensure the outsourcing model delivers the expected economic efficiency.

**Contributing Responsibilities**
**Recruitment & Onboarding Execution**

* Demand Translation: Convert onshore technical requirements into detailed hiring plans (profile, timing, and priority).
* Talent Coordination: Orchestrate the end-to-end recruitment workflow within ISPL (screening, interviews, and offers) to ensure a seamless talent pipeline.
* Onboarding Management: Support the rapid onboarding of resources to meet project ramp-up needs and ensure "day-one" readiness.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic Sourcing & Procurement: Mastery of the end-to-end sourcing lifecycle (RFP, RFI, RFQ) within a complex IT environment.
* Contract Management: Deep understanding of commercial contract law, specifically regarding IT services, intellectual property, and data privacy.
* Vendor Risk Management (VRM): Ability to assess and mitigate third-party risks in alignment with IT Risk Management and Cybersecurity frameworks.
* Financial Acumen: Proficiency in cost-benefit analysis, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) modeling, and managing complex pricing structures.
* IT Domain Awareness: Foundational understanding of IT infrastructure, application development, and cloud services to communicate effectively with technical beneficiaries.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Stakeholder Influence & Negotiation: Exceptional ability to manage expectations and negotiate effectively with both internal onshore beneficiaries and external vendor executives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work seamlessly across IT, HR, Finance, and Procurement functions to achieve project goals.
* Analytical Thinking: Capability to synthesize complex technical requirements and market data into clear strategic recommendations.
* Communication Excellence: High proficiency in articulating commercial and strategic concepts to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment between onshore needs and offshore delivery.
* Integrity & Professionalism: Unwavering commitment to ethical sourcing practices and compliance with Group standards.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Strategic Sourcing/Procurement expertise
* Contract Law fundamentals
* Vendor Risk Management (VRM)
* Financial Modeling/Cost Analysis
* Familiarity with IT Service Management

**Behavioral Skills**

* Advanced Negotiation skills
* Strong Commercial Acumen
* Ethical Integrity

Master’s Degree

8+ years of experience

Chennai

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. Strong Knowledge on PLM, GD&T & Tolerance stack up study

title: Manager II - Onboarding ( Investment Banking)
description:
**Role Description**
Head of Onboarding & Event Management India ( Investment Banking)
  
  
Overview of Role
  
  
The Onboarding & Event Management Module is comprised of 4 key pillars:
  
  
Data Management,
  
  
Third party setup,
  
  
Derivative Onboarding and Broker Management.
  
  
The team is tasked with delivering all onboarding activities required to bring a Client or Client Fund to life on our Investment platform.
  
  
The primary responsibility of this candidate is to efficiently manage the delivery of the end-to-end setup, maintenance, and closure of mandates, portfolios, agreements, and related accounts across key systems. You will be responsible for developing and managing a multiskilled team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor and develop team members across multiple locations fostering a culture of collaboration and openness.
* Oversee daily operations and performance of the team, ensuring delivery of a high-quality service to clients and stakeholders.
* Work with the Head of Onboarding Delivery & Oversight to manage prioritisation of onboarding activities.
* Manage the teams capacity, ensuring all activities are allocated, monitored and delivered against agreed timelines and SLA’s
* Identify end-to-end process enhancements for efficiency gains and risk reduction, ensuring all changes are agreed before being implemented.
* Monitor market and regulatory changes and where required implement changes to processes and procedures
* Ensure strict adherence to all procedures and ensure that process outcomes are fully trackable and auditable.
* Ensure strict adherence to group policies and compliance within your function.
* Ensure risk is managed and our risk recording policy is strictly adhered to and notify the Head of Global Platform Onboarding as any issues arrive.
* Monitor and review error trends to prevent reoccurrence.

Overview of the areas you will be responsible for delivering:
  
  
**Data Management**

* Set up, maintain and close mandates, portfolios and accounts across Aladdin, IRIS and Client business data masters.
* Maintain core operational data, including Aladdin Accounting data, settlement instructions, trade delivery configuration and cash flow notifications.
* Set up and maintain related third-party and counterparty data, including pay away brokers, credit risk counterparties, custodians and external reporting.
* Perform quality assurance checks to keep data aligned across platforms and in line with agreed rules.
* Review data quality control exceptions to support strong data governance and maintain high data standards.

Derivative Onboarding:
  
  

* Open derivative trading accounts covering OTC Bilateral, OTC Cleared, FX, ETD, Term Deposits, TBA’s, CFD’s and Loans with external market vendors, ensuring the end-to-end process is delivered on time.
* Document all required onboarding information clearly and keep key parties updated from initiation through to completion.
* Maintain accurate operational data across internal databases and external platforms.
* Keep due diligence documentation up to date in Markit KYC and ensure broker permissions are appropriate and approved.
* Support process improvement, maintain operating controls, and respond to counterparty and broker queries quickly and clearly. Broker management:
* Onboard and maintain broker relationships across Clients systems, including execution brokers, term deposit brokers and related accounts.
* Complete financial crime due diligence for new broker relationships and monitor existing relationships on an ongoing basis.
* Distribute Clients due diligence documentation and Terms of Business to brokers as required.
* Support effective team delivery by mentoring Broker Management colleagues, identifying training gaps and keeping procedures up to date.
* Drive process improvements, ensure controls and operating guidelines are followed, and escalate issues promptly to the Onboarding Manager. 3rd Party Setup:
* Complete custodian account opening documentation and support market openings for clients and Client funds, including complex documented markets and repatriation of non base currencies
* Manage custodian standing instructions, settlement instructions in DTCC
* Set up and maintain third-party, Wall Street Office, and Triana accounts to support CFD and loan trading.
* Maintain broker-related macros, validate market accounts before trading, and support smooth trade settlement.
* Monitor India trading accounts, complete FPI licence renewals
* Support Global Custodian Direct implementation projects.

***What you'll be like***

* 15+ years of experience gained within an Asset Management operations team or other Financial Services team delivering some or all of these onboarding activities.
* Experience within a senior operations management role
* Experience of developing and managing a multiskilled team
* Proven track record of enhancing processes and procedures
* Excellent understanding of operational risk
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for effectively interacting with internal and external teams, ensuring that all parties are informed and aligned throughout the onboarding process.
* Strong organisational abilities are needed to manage the delivery of multiple events simultaneously, prioritising tasks and maintaining a smooth and efficient workflow.
* The ability to identify issues and develop solutions quickly and effectively is important for addressing any challenges that may arise during the onboarding process.
* In depth understanding of industry regulations and compliance requirements
* The ability to analyse data and workflows to implement processes change and enhance the efficiency of the onboarding delivery
* Strong relationship management and senior stakeholder engagement skills.
* Open, receptive and curious about new ideas that challenges the status quo and encourages the same from their team members. Applications / System experience
* Aladdin
* Workflow and Case Management tools
* DTCC
* OA / RFA

description:
**People Manager & Business Activity Owner (BAO) - Center of Excellence**
**Introduction**
We are establishing a new Business Activity Owner (BAO) Center of Excellence (CoE) and are seeking a strong, strategic leader to build and guide one of its core teams. This is a "dual-hat" People Manager role responsible for leading, developing, and inspiring a team of BAO professionals while also managing a portfolio of Technology & Business Enablement’s (T&BE) third-party relationships.
  
  
This role requires an experienced leader with a strategic mindset, strong business acumen, and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, constantly evolving environment. Success in this position depends on sound judgment, accountability, effective decision-making, and a commitment to developing talent. The role also requires balancing operational excellence with people leadership, fostering both high performance and a culture that supports professional growth and healthy work-life integration.
  
  
**Leadership & Management Responsibilities**
As a People Manager within the CoE, your primary responsibility is to your team. We have high expectations for our leaders, and you will be accountable for:
  
  

* Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of BAO professionals. Foster a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
* Strategic Vision: Develop and execute a strategic vision for your team, proactively identifying opportunities for optimization and aligning with the ever-changing technology and vendor strategy.
* Financial Oversight: Manage financial tasks and budgets related to your team and vendor portfolio.
* Resilience & Adaptability: Handle pressure with composure and guide your team through a dynamic and ever-changing environment.
* Empathetic Leadership: Be present and attentive to your team's success, actively promoting a healthy work-life balance and ensuring their well-being.
* Ownership & Accountability: Demonstrate strong professional intelligence and the ability to think independently. You will be expected to make decisive calls and own the outcomes, learning and iterating from both successes and failures.

**Business Activity Owner (BAO) Responsibilities**
In addition to your leadership duties, you will act as the designated BAO for a select portfolio of vendor relationships. You will be hands-on in executing the end-to-end responsibilities for these critical suppliers.
  
  
**Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Define Business Needs: Collaborate with internal teams to clearly define business requirements for engaging a third-party.
* Risk Assessment: Initiate and complete the Inherent Risk Questionnaire (IRQ) to determine the risk profile of the relationship.
* Engage Sourcing: Partner with Sourcing to conduct sourcing events and select the appropriate third-party.
* Coordinate Due Diligence: Manage the comprehensive due diligence process with various control assessment groups.
* Contracting: Oversee the contracting process, securing approvals and ensuring correct setup.

**Ongoing Monitoring & Management**

* Performance Management: Continuously monitor and report on third-party performance against Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Risk & Control Assessments: Perform Ongoing Monitoring (OGM) control assessments and address any identified gaps.
* Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the third-party and manage escalations.
* Process Improvement: Proactively identify trends, drive supplier optimization, and make recommendations to improve ways of working.
* Compliance: Stay current on industry regulations and ensure the third-party relationship remains compliant, including managing renewals and amendments.

**Offboarding**

* Termination: Manage the decision and execution of the termination process, ensuring a smooth transition.

**Qualifications**
**Leadership Qualifications**

* Management Experience: Proven experience in leading, mentoring, and developing teams is required. This is ideally demonstrated by 2+ years of a formal people management role, however significant experience acting as a team lead, project lead, or senior mentor for a group of colleagues will be strongly considered.
* Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to think strategically, look forward, and align team execution with broader business and technology strategy.
* Decisiveness & Accountability: Demonstrated history of making independent decisions and taking full ownership of the results.
* Emotional Intelligence: Strong ability to lead with empathy, manage team dynamics, and remain composed under pressure.

**BAO & Professional Qualifications**

* Experience: 2+ years of experience in a supplier/third-party management, vendor management, project management, or risk management role.
* Project Management: Excellent project management, planning, and organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage and track multiple complex tasks simultaneously.
* Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal, collaboration, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present complex and sensitive issues clearly to senior management.
* Problem Solving: A proactive and analytical mindset with the ability to handle ad-hoc requests, remediate issues, and drive resolutions.
* Adaptability: A desire to learn, tackle new challenges, and thrive in an evolving role.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Tooling: Experience working with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms such as Aravo and OneTPM.
* Global Experience: Experience working with other countries and business areas in a global organization.
* Language: Multi-lingual (writing/reading/speaking) capabilities.

This leader will be responsible for bringing together platforms, engineering practices, operational processes, and data to improve availability, resiliency, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across mission-critical technology services.
  
  
The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**How You Will Make an Impact**
**Engineering & Platform Leadership**

* Lead engineering and platform capabilities supporting ServiceNow/ITSM, Strategy, and Customer Journeys.
* Establish and execute multi-year platform and engineering strategies aligned with organizational priorities.
* Drive modernization of platform architecture, engineering practices, automation, integrations, and data capabilities.
* Establish standards for software quality, testing, deployment, security, scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
* Ensure critical platforms meet expectations for availability, performance, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance.
* Develop strong technical talent and create organizational depth while establishing clear accountability and ownership.

**ServiceNow, ITSM & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and engineering leadership for ServiceNow and associated enterprise ITSM capabilities, with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB development as it relates to those areas.
* Establish and evolve a technology roadmap for these capabilities that aligns ServiceNow development with enterprise operational, reliability, risk, product owners, and business priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry standards, established practices, and emerging trends across ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management and use that knowledge to inform platform strategy and engineering priorities.
* Ensure CMDB capabilities supporting Incident, Problem, and Change processes provide accurate, useful, and sustainable configuration and relationship data.
* Drive integration across Incident, Problem, Change, and CMDB capabilities so that configuration data strengthens impact analysis, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, operational decision-making, and automation.
* Partner with ITSM process owners and technology stakeholders to translate process strategy into scalable ServiceNow capabilities.
* Participate in and influence the ServiceNow roadmap through established governance, prioritization, and planning forums, representing the needs and priorities of SRE, Application Support, Operations Engineering, and other technology stakeholders.
* Build alignment across process owners, platform teams, engineering organizations, and senior leaders on ServiceNow priorities, investments, sequencing, and technical direction.
* Challenge unnecessary process or platform complexity while ensuring appropriate controls, governance, and auditability.

**You will join our High-Rise Buildings**
**Department**
As our new
**Senior Technical Lead BIM - High Rise Structure**
, you will be part of our global High-Rise department, Ramboll’s dedicated team of Highrise experts which have designed over 150 tall building projects globally, including some of the most technically challenging. You would be responsible to coordinate with project managers and/or engineers for Analysis and Design work in the Highrise department in Chennai to support the global department which also has offices in Copenhagen, UK, Middle East, and Singapore.
  
  
**The BIM Lead owns day-to-day resourcing and quality performance of the BIM function, which sits entirely within REC. The role gives the BIM function a single point of accountability for resource allocation, output quality and staff development.**
**Job Description**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Allocate BIM staff across active projects in line with project delivery plans and the Department's resourcing methodology.
* Identify resourcing gaps or conflicts early and raise them to the Head of Department and the relevant Project Lead before they affect delivery, in line with the Project Delivery and Governance Guideline.
* Own overall BIM output quality and drawing presentation standards across REC.
* Set and monitor productivity and quality standards for the BIM team, distinct from the project-level quality checks performed by the BIM Quality Lead and Senior BIM Coordinator(s).
* Escalate any resourcing decision beyond the Department's established methodology, and any matter that cannot be resolved through coordination with the Quality function or the relevant Project Lead, to the Head of Department.
* Maintain visibility of BIM team capacity and utilisation across REC.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver a structured training scheme for the BIM team, covering software proficiency, modelling standards and productivity.
* Assign team members to the training scheme and track completion and resulting quality/productivity improvement.
* Identify individual skill gaps and provide or arrange targeted training as needed.
* Coordinate with Project Leads and Project BIM Leads on project-specific BIM resourcing and delivery needs.
* Report resourcing status, training progress and quality trends to the Head of Department on a regular basis.

**Ideal Character Type**

* Hands-on and detail-focused: comfortable reviewing models and drawings directly, not managing purely at a distance.
* Owns resourcing and quality outcomes; escalates early rather than explaining late.
* Calm and structured under multiple concurrent project deadlines.
* Coaching mindset: builds capability in the team through training rather than working around gaps.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in a relevant BIM, architectural technology or engineering discipline.
* Minimum 25 years of relevant BIM experience, including substantial experience in a managerial or lead capacity with direct responsibility for team and resource management, ideally within a multi-disciplinary structural or MEP design environment.
* Proven track record with top-tier engineering consultancies in the region.
* Relevant professional accreditations required.
* Demonstrated experience designing or delivering structured training programmes for technical teams.
* Strong working knowledge of BIM standards, modelling software (e.g. Revit) and quality/productivity benchmarking.

**Why This Role May Interest You**

* Genuine ownership of the BIM function's resourcing, quality standards and training programme.
* A newly defined role with a direct hand in shaping how BIM is structured across REC.
* Group backing for the tools and training the function needs.

**Additional Information**
**Working at Ramboll**
To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. Thus, the possibilities at Ramboll are many and diverse –we invest a lot in the development of people and offer career paths tailored for each individual.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are interested in applying, please send your application through our online recruitment system by clicking the link ‘apply’ below. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Assistant Vice President - Treasury Financial Control
description:

This will include impairment, classification and measurement work stream including implementation of the new standard for the local entity reporting where applicable.

* Strong team management skills.
* Stakeholder management experience.
* Good analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Strong control awareness.
* Techno-functional knowledge to handle finance and technology teams.
* Prior experience in project management.
* Experience in finance especially month-end or quarter-end focused reporting role.
* Previous experience with having used either SAP or Hyperion.

**Some Other Highly Values Skills Include,**

* Good stakeholder engagement skills and understanding & executing their requirements / expectations
* Knowledge and understanding of the key accounting principles under IFRS
* Experience in Banking industry.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role will be based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To manage the financial operations of the organisation, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.

* Development and implementation of up-to-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Cinema Advertisement Operations - Manager

* Validate advertisement content received from clients and agencies

* Track campaign playback through monitoring systems and playback logs

* Validate playback reports and campaign logs for invoicing purposes

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign execution reports

* Partner with Sales teams during campaign planning and execution
* Support clients with execution updates, campaign reports, and issue resolution
* Participate in pre-campaign feasibility assessments
* Ensure service-level agreements (SLAs) are consistently achieved

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies and automation
* Develop SOPs and operational best practices
* Collaborate with technology teams for system enhancements
* Lead initiatives to improve campaign visibility, reporting accuracy, and operational productivity

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Media Management, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related field
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification preferred

**Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in Advertisement Operations, Media Operations, Cinema Advertising, Broadcast Operations, or Digital Media Operations
* Experience managing multi-location campaign execution and reporting
* Experience working with theatre networks, media agencies, and advertisers is preferred

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Power BI
* SQL and Data Analysis
* Campaign Scheduling Systems
* ERP and CRM Platforms
* MIS Reporting and Dashboard Development
* Process Automation Tools

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong Operational Management Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Focus
* Communication & Coordination
* Time Management
* Decision Making
* Team Leadership

**Role Objective**
To ensure flawless execution of cinema advertising campaigns across the theatre network through efficient content deployment, playback monitoring, client servicing, revenue assurance, reporting, and continuous process improvement, thereby maximizing client satisfaction and advertising revenue.

title: Marine Superintendent

Executive Ship Management (ESM), part of the Executive Group of Companies headquartered in Singapore, is a trusted partner to leading global ship owners and major industry players who demand high standards, quality, and professionalism. The company operates a world-class maritime institute in India, the Samundra Institute of Maritime Studies (SIMS), to ensure that its vessels are managed by specially trained officers and crew. ESM maintains a robust, in-house recruitment, training, and vetting process, building a strong pool of skilled seafarers for advanced and specialized vessels. With resource centers across India and support offices in Houston, Rotterdam, and Tokyo, ESM leverages advanced information technology and innovative ship management solutions to enhance performance at sea and on shore. Guided by a strong quality culture, ESM is committed to safety, security, and the holistic development of its people, assets, and long-term partnerships.
  
**Role Description**
The Marine Superintendent is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, responsible for overseeing the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of assigned vessels. This role involves monitoring day-to-day vessel performance, guiding shipboard teams on marine operations, and ensuring adherence to company policies, international regulations, and industry best practices. The Marine Superintendent will coordinate with ship management and technical teams on voyage planning, incident prevention, audits, and inspections, including vetting and port state control requirements. The role includes reviewing operational reports, conducting ship visits, supporting crew in the implementation of safety management systems, and driving continuous improvement in vessel operations. The Marine Superintendent will also collaborate with stakeholders, including owners and charterers, to maintain high standards of professionalism and operational reliability.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong expertise in Marine Operations and Vessel Operations, including navigation, cargo handling, and safety procedures.
* Candidates should possess solid experience in Ship Management, covering compliance, maintenance oversight, and coordination with technical and crewing teams.
* Candidates should possess proven Supervisory Skills to guide shipboard personnel, conduct performance reviews, and support training and development.
* Candidates should possess hands-on knowledge of Vetting processes, audits, inspections, and alignment with oil major and industry requirements.
* Candidates should ideally have a Class 1 or Class 2 certificate of competency (deck or engine) with relevant sea-going experience.
* Candidates should possess strong understanding of international maritime regulations (ISM, ISPS, MARPOL, SOLAS) and quality, health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, report-writing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work in a multicultural environment.
* Candidates should possess good analytical and problem-solving abilities, familiarity with fleet management or maritime software, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

description:

title: Process Engineering Manager
description:
**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Build, lead, and develop a Body Process Simulation team supporting BIW manufacturing engineering activities.
* Define team structure, technical responsibilities, engineering standards, work processes, deliverables, and performance expectations.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of engineers, simulation specialists, controls engineers, contractors, and supplier resources.
* Recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in process simulation, robotics, offline programming, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs, training plans, and career development pathways.
* Manage resource planning, project workloads, budgets, supplier support, and delivery performance across multiple manufacturing programs and locations.
* Foster a culture focused on safety, collaboration, innovation, quality, continuous improvement, and standardization.

**Process Simulation & Digital Manufacturing**

* Lead the application of Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or similar digital manufacturing tools to validate body shop manufacturing processes prior to equipment installation.
* Establish standard methodologies for:
* Robot reach and accessibility studies
* Collision detection and avoidance
* Cycle time validation
* Tooling and weld gun accessibility validation
* Ergonomic assessments
* Robot path optimization
* Station layout verification
* Ensure simulation activities support manufacturing feasibility reviews, equipment design validation, tooling development, and process planning.
* Develop and maintain simulation models, robot libraries, tooling standards, process libraries, work instructions, and best practices.
* Improve simulation quality, model accuracy, data management practices, and process validation efficiency.
* Identify and communicate manufacturing risks, design concerns, capacity constraints, automation challenges, and process issues early during program development.

**Virtual Commissioning**

* Develop organizational capability in virtual commissioning technologies and methodologies.
* Lead validation of robot sequences, programmable logic controller (PLC) logic, safety interlocks, equipment interfaces, and automated manufacturing processes in a virtual environment.
* Define virtual commissioning standards, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and deployment methodologies.
* Collaborate with Controls Engineering, equipment suppliers, and plant teams to ensure an effective transition from virtual to physical commissioning.
* Support issue resolution related to robotics, controls, automation systems, simulation models, commissioning activities, and production support.

**Automation & Digital Transformation**

* Drive automation and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve simulation efficiency, engineering productivity, and manufacturing validation processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate model creation, reporting, data validation, engineering analysis, and repetitive simulation activities.
* Support the adoption of advanced digital tools, data analytics, digital twins, and AI-enabled engineering solutions to improve:
* Engineering productivity
* Manufacturing risk identification
* Root-cause analysis
* Knowledge management
* Decision support
* Partner with Manufacturing IT, Controls Engineering, Product Development, and Data & Analytics teams to evaluate and implement scalable digital manufacturing solutions.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.
