title: AVP - Treasury PC
description:
Become part of Barclays as AVP \- Treasury Product Control, where purpose of the role is perform Analytical review of securities, fees and investment income for investment banking business. This includes understanding the nature of each business, explaining the movements in Balance sheet/P\&L, identifying the control gaps. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating.
   

  

**To Be Successful, In This Role You Should Have**
* Product control experience in Investment bank.
* In\-depth knowledge of Financial product and markets of the relevant governance control.
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end processes of an IB (Investment Banking) and associated controls.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings and the ability to interact.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* CFA / Masters in Finance / Financial Engineering.
* Good control awareness and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently with a spectrum of people from junior finance staff to front office business heads.
* Mature and able to negotiate through difficult situations.
* Good influencing and negotiation skills and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in our Chennai office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P\&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P\&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Network Engineering Lead
description:

**Role/ Job Title:** 
 Network Engineering Lead
   

  

**Function/ Department:** 
 Information Technology.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 The primary responsibility will be managing the 24x7 DC/DR/NDR network, Pan India, Network Support \& Operations. You will work closely with the teams from Network Projects, EUS leads, NOC and other cross\-functional teams who are managing systems and applications, to drive efficiency and improvements in supporting/managing the business.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Should analyse, design, implement and maintain the networks F5 and Citrix NetScaler Load Balancer infrastructure.
* Should inspect data packets and TCP, IP flow in network and application flow.
* should possess a working knowledge of switches, routers, and firewall concepts.
* Should be able to configure and maintain F5 and Citrix Load Balancers, load balancing best practices.
* Should also take the responsibility to upgrade network operating systems software and hardware as per the management requirements.
* Must ensure that the plans are integrated effectively with the other aspects of the technical infrastructure.
* Extensive knowledge of Load balancing technology including algorithms and health check options.
* Knowledge and experience regarding F5 BIG\-IP LTM VIP configuration with health check.
* Knowledge and experience with F5 BIG\-IP GTM Wide IP configuration.
* F5 BIG\-IP iRule programming and troubleshooting experience.
* Extensive knowledge of Citrix NetScaler VIP configuration with health check.
* Knowledge and experience with Citrix NetScaler Global Load Balancing (Gslb) configuration.
* Candidate Must have extensive experience working in structured change management, Problem and Incident processes.
* Candidate Must have production environment experience consisting of Global load balancing, Local load balancing, SSL acceleration, HTTP compression / caching, and DNS.
* Candidate Must have strong Networking Experience \- TCP / IP, Administration of networking hardware.
* Candidate Must have design and maintenance experience with complex Web hosting network architectures.
* Experience directly managing routers, switches, load balancers and SSL accelerators in a high\-availability infrastructure is required.
* Expert understanding of TCP as it pertains to packet inspection and network / application flows.
* Expert ability to troubleshoot issues and make recommendations for system changes, as needed, to resolve issues.
* must have integration / configuration / administration experience and possess a solid Network background including an understanding of switch, network routing, and firewall concepts.
* The Load Balancing Engineer must possess very strong troubleshooting skills as well as a strong TCP understanding as it pertains to packet inspection and TCP flow in the Network and Application flows.
* The Load Balancing Engineer must have a very good understanding of DNS functionality and concepts as it relates to IPv4 and IPv6\.
* Deep understanding of network protocols (Routing / Switching)
* Design and implement Load balancing rules using industry best practices.
* Communicate network architecture designs clearly and effectively to technical and non\-technical decision makers
* Perform security hardening of network systems.
* Develop or contribute to technical documentation including Low Level design documentation, Technical Implementation document, deployment/build plans, and test plans.
* Deploy designed solution within a testing environment to verify compliance with security and functional requirements.


**Education Qualification:**
 Graduation: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) / Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
   

  

 Post\-Graduation: Master of Science (M.Sc) /Master of Technology (M.Tech) / Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10\-18 years.

title: Manager – Financial Operations
description:
Management Level
   

  

 F
   

  

 EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Manager – Financial Operations**
 The Manager, Financial Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of all finance activities processed through the organisation's Workday/ERP platform. The role acts as the global process owner for Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and direct oversight of UK Payroll processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely financial reporting, strong controls, and optimal use of Workday/ERP capabilities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with the ability to develop high\-performing teams, build organisational capability, and drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
   

  

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Process Ownership**
* Lead the delivery of finance operations across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and Payroll processes.
* Own operational performance, ensuring delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Ensure standardised, efficient, and well\-controlled end\-to\-end finance processes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues and process exceptions.


**People Management**
* Lead, develop, and motivate a high\-performing Finance Operations team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities to enhance capability and engagement.
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and skills development to ensure long\-term organisational resilience.


**Accounts Payable Operations**
* Oversee invoice processing, payment execution, employee expenses, and supplier account management.
* Ensure timely supplier payments and effective resolution of payment\-related issues.
* Maintain strong AP controls, compliance, and governance standards.
* Act as the functional owner for Workday Accounts Payable processes and enhancements.


**Record\-to\-Report Operations**
* Ensure timely and accurate journal processing and financial accounting activities.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalisation, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
* Manage balance sheet reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and prepayment accounting.
* Support statutory, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvements across RTR processes to improve efficiency, control, and reporting quality.


**Procurement Operations**
* Manage Purchase Order (PO) support processes.
* Oversee supplier onboarding activities and vendor master governance.
* Support procurement compliance and policy adherence.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive efficient purchasing processes.
* Support supplier negotiations and process optimisation initiatives.


**Payroll Operations (UK)**
* Oversee UK payroll processing, validation, reconciliations, and payroll accounting activities.
* Ensure payroll operations are delivered accurately, compliantly, and on time.
* Review payroll journals, controls, and exception management processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of payroll queries and exceptions.
* Partner with HR and external providers to maintain a high\-quality payroll service.


**Workday/ERP Governance \& Optimisation**
* Act as the Finance SME for Workday/ERP processes and functionality.
* Drive maximum utilisation of system capabilities through automation and process standardisation.
* Partner with Technology and Business teams on system enhancements and process changes.


**Performance Management \& Reporting**
* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor productivity, service levels, quality, and control metrics.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular management information to Finance leadership.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Simplify workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support Finance transformation and change initiatives.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
* Strong experience across Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Financial Accounting environments.
* End\-to\-end knowledge of Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Fixed Assets, and UK Payroll processes.
* Experience of operating and optimising ERP platforms, preferably Workday.
* Strong understanding of Month\-End and year\-end financial close processes.
* Experience delivering operational excellence, automation, and process transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and levels.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to lead change and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**
* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) or equivalent


**SKILLS:**
* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required
* Achievement orientation: Driven by goals and deadlines
* Ability to work well with people across the organisation.
* Ability to understand the detail behind processes.


 We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. Please note any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory pre\-employment screening checks.

title: Metricstream Delivery Lead
description:
**ERM Industrial Assets Department**
 We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven MetricStream Delivery Lead to oversee the successful delivery of MetricStream solutions at Glencore. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project management, excellent leadership skills, and a deep understanding of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. You will be responsible for delivering to project timelines and manage technical and functional resources both internally as well as with Glencore’s third\-party vendors. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams across multiple locations globally.
   

  

**The main tasks and responsibilities include:**
* Lead the delivery of MetricStream implementation at Glencore, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT, business stakeholders, and external vendors, to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including resource allocation and timelines.
* Monitor project progress to plan, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely delivery.
* Facilitate regular project meetings to communicate status, address challenges and escalations as necessary.
* Ensure adherence to best practices and standards in project management and GRC implementations.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance environment.


**Technical Experience:**
* Degree (e.g., BA, BSc) or professional certifications in computer science, Information technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years’ experience delivering and managing MetricStream implementations in global organizations.
* Proven experience as a delivery lead, preferably with MetricStream or similar GRC platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Project).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on delivering results.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written \& ability to collaborate across departments and cultures
* Knowledge of MetricStream features and technology (BAPI journeys, PL\-SQL, JAVA and MetricStream reporting tools, Power BI etc.)
* Knowledge of data governance and the integration of Risk, Audit, and HSEC processes.


**Key strengths include:**
* A solutions\-focused individual who can work with teams through complex challenges while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification is a plus.
* Familiarity with compliance, risk management, and audit processes.
* Awareness of natural resources sector compliance challenges and emerging GRC \& ERM trends, is a plus.


**Benefits**
* We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.
* We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.
* We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.


**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
   

  

 Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

 To build a high\-performance, professionally managed organization by strengthening the leadership bench, enhancing operational and financial discipline, and executing a structured growth strategy to achieve 3X revenue expansion in 4 years, while establishing governance, compliance, and investor readiness frameworks to enable a successful IPO in the 5–6 year horizon.

* Identify new geographies, product diversification, and technology partnerships.
* Evaluate M\&A / JV opportunities aligned with scale and valuation goals.
* Build a strong equity story in preparation for IPO.

title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Deputy Manager- Execution
description:
**Job Description**
**Your Responsibilities:**
 We are looking for a dynamic Trade Execution \& Port Operations professional to manage end\-to\-end execution of edible oil imports and domestic trade operations. The role will be responsible for execution of import and local purchase contracts, vessel operations, customs coordination, terminal operations, inventory management, customer deliveries, documentation, cost control, and stakeholder management across multiple ports including JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and Haldia.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in handling imported edible oils such as Crude Palm Oil (CPO), Degummed Soybean Oil (DSO), Sunflower Oil, RBD and other bulk liquid commodities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Trade Execution
   

  

* Manage complete execution of purchase and sales contracts from contract confirmation until final settlement.
* Ensure timely execution of import shipments with minimal operational and financial risk.
* Coordinate contract nominations, shipment schedules, delivery plans, and execution timelines.
* Monitor contractual obligations and ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms.
* Maintain accurate trade position and execution status.


 Port \& Terminal Operations
   

  

* Independently manage day\-to\-day operations at JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and other assigned ports.
* Coordinate vessel discharge operations with shipping agents, tank terminals, surveyors, customs brokers, and transporters.
* Monitor vessel berthing, discharge progress, storage utilization, and cargo evacuation.
* Ensure timely completion of discharge operations while minimizing demurrage, detention, and operational delays.
* Coordinate local purchase unloading and customer loading operations.


 Customs \& Documentation
   

  

* Track Bill of Entry (BOE) filing and customs clearance.
* Coordinate with Customs House Agents (CHA), shipping lines, and regulatory authorities.
* Monitor duty payments and customs\-related compliance.
* Ensure timely availability of import documents for cargo clearance.


 Customer \& Supplier Coordination
   

  

* Act as the primary execution contact for buyers, suppliers, shipping companies, tank terminals, surveyors, inspectors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate delivery orders, cargo lifting schedules, sampling, inspections, and documentation.
* Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform margin calculations, revised pricing, duty variance calculations, and commercial settlements.
* Process Debit Notes (DN), Credit Notes (CN), and trade settlements.
* Verify invoices before processing


 Inventory \& Quality Management
   

  

* Monitor stock positions across terminals.
* Coordinate quality inspections, sampling, and survey reports.
* Ensure accurate inventory reconciliation.
* Coordinate quality and weight settlements with suppliers and buyers while minimizing commercial exposure.
* Monitor execution costs and identify opportunities for operational savings.
* Review port, terminal, survey, transport, and warehouse costs.
* Support vendor invoice verification and non\-raw material vendor payments.


 Reporting \& MIS, Process Improvement \& Compliance
   

  

* Maintain execution records and operational documentation.
* Prepare Daily Discharge Reports (DDR), vessel status reports, stock reports, and execution MIS.
* Update SharePoint and ERP systems with execution data.
* Prepare month\-end operational reports and support financial closing activities.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, trade compliance, food safety, and statutory requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining complete documentation.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Trading, Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Customs, and Legal teams.
* Build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, terminals, surveyors, transporters, shipping agents, and government authorities.
* Maintain accurate execution records.
* Support ERP implementation and digital initiatives.
* Perform additional execution\-related responsibilities assigned by management.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Timely execution of purchase and sales contracts.
* Zero operational disruptions due to execution lapses.
* Minimized demurrage, detention, and avoidable logistics costs.
* Accurate BOE tracking and customs clearance.
* Timely customer deliveries and cargo lifting.
* Inventory accuracy and stock reconciliation.
* Timely completion of commercial settlements (DN/CN).
* Accuracy of MIS and operational reporting.
* Strong compliance with SOPs and audit requirements.
* Continuous improvement through cost\-saving and process optimization initiatives.


**Your Profile**
 Preferred Experience
   

  

* 5–10 years of experience in Trade Execution, Import Operations, Port Operations, or Supply Chain.
* Experience in edible oil imports is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience managing bulk liquid cargo operations.
* Experience handling multiple ports simultaneously.


**Preferred Commodity Experience**
* Crude Palm Oil (CPO) /Crude Deggumed Soybean Oil /Refined Oils /Crude Sunflower Oil /Other edible oil commodities

description:
As a Product Strategy and Operations Manager, you will work closely with the Product Strategy and Operations Manager and the Product leadership team, partnering across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Finance. This is an ideal first role for a fresh MBA graduate who wants exposure to how a fast\-scaling product organisation actually runs — you'll learn by doing, with real ownership from day one.
 



 You will:
 


* Support the P\&E rhythm of business — helping coordinate roadmap reviews, sprint planning, launch readiness, post\-launch retrospectives, and QBRs — and help build the operating cadence that keeps the product organisation structured and predictable.
* Help track the product metrics that matter: activation, adoption, retention, expansion, and their leading indicators. Assist in building out the "product landing" framework — a structured post\-launch process that ensures new features are actually adopted and generate learnings for the next iteration.
* Support the product\-level analysis of pricing and packaging — how capabilities are bundled, how value is communicated at each tier, and how new AI modules affect the overall commercial model.
* Assist Finance and Sales on pricing changes — building models of customer impact and helping structure the internal and external communication around pricing evolution.
* Help develop ROI frameworks and value metrics for each product area, which Marketing and Sales can use in positioning and commercial conversations.
* Support the sales enablement process — working with Sales and Marketing to help set targets, build plans, and track tactics that drive pipeline generation, CSAT, and adoption.
* Help build and maintain competitive intelligence systems that give product leaders an up\-to\-date view of the market landscape.



**What We're Looking For** 



* 7\+ years of Product Management or related experience, with atleast 3 years focused on Unified Endpoint Management, Mobile Device management (MDM), or enterprise security solutions.
* Candidates from premier B\-schools such as
 **ISB, IIMs, or equivalent institutions** 
 , with a specialization or strong interest in
 **Strategy, Operations, Product Management, or General Management** 
 .
* Familiarity with enterprise IT environments , including Active Directory, Azure AD, and network security protocols.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with comfort working with data to build frameworks, dashboards, and business cases.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to structure and present ideas clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating with ambiguity — the kind of environment typical of an early\-stage, fast\-scaling product organisation.

title: Plant Manager / Production Manager
description:
For our Client:
 



  





 Chemical Blending Facility – Speciality Chemicals
 



  





 Position Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager / Production Manager to lead the setup, commissioning, and ongoing operations of a chemical blending facility for the manufacture of detergents, surfactants, and dicing fluids. The role will be responsible for safe, efficient, quality\-driven, and compliant plant operations, including production planning, batch manufacturing, raw material handling, packaging, maintenance coordination, manpower management, and continuous improvement.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bring strong hands\-on experience in chemical blending, specialty chemicals, surfactants, detergents, lubricants, process chemicals, personal care chemicals, or related formulation\-based manufacturing environments, along with proven leadership of plant teams and adherence to safety, quality, and statutory requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead day\-to\-day production operations for chemical blending, mixing, filtration, filling, packaging, storage, and dispatch activities.
 



 Manage plant setup activities including layout readiness, equipment installation support, utilities coordination, trial batches, commissioning, and operational handover.
 



 Ensure all batches are manufactured strictly as per approved formulations, batch sheets, SOPs, work instructions, and quality specifications.
 



 Plan production schedules based on customer requirements, raw material availability, manpower, equipment capacity, and delivery commitments.
 



 Supervise handling, storage, charging, transfer, and use of chemicals including surfactants, solvents, additives, builders, preservatives, pH adjusters, fragrances, and specialty performance additives.
 



 Maintain strong control over batch yields, rework, wastage, spillage, process losses, and product consistency.
 



 Coordinate closely with Quality Control / Quality Assurance for raw material release, in\-process checks, finished product testing, non\-conformance handling, and corrective actions.
 



 Implement and enforce EHS practices related to chemical handling, PPE, MSDS/SDS compliance, spill response, fire safety, hazardous storage, effluent control, and emergency preparedness.
 



 Maintain compliance with applicable factory, labour, environmental, statutory, ISO, customer, and internal audit requirements.
 



 Lead, train, schedule, and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, helpers, and contract employees across shifts.
 



 Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to ensure preventive maintenance, breakdown response, calibration, utility reliability, and equipment uptime.
 



 Monitor production performance using KPIs such as output, batch cycle time, right\-first\-time quality, OEE, downtime, yield, cost, rejection rate, and on\-time delivery.
 



 Maintain accurate plant documentation, including batch records, production reports, stock records, shift logs, equipment cleaning records, EHS records, and audit trails.
 



 Drive continuous improvement initiatives in productivity, safety, housekeeping, process standardization, material usage, energy efficiency, and cost reduction.
 



 Support procurement, stores, warehouse, logistics, R\&D, technical service, and commercial teams to ensure smooth end\-to\-end operations.
 



 Required Qualifications and Experience
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, Chemistry, Polymer Science, Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 



 Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in chemical manufacturing, preferably in chemical blending, detergents, surfactants, specialty chemicals, metalworking fluids, dicing fluids, lubricants, process chemicals, home care, personal care, coatings, adhesives, or similar formulation\-based industries.
 



 At least 3–5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial production role with responsibility for teams, shifts, production targets, safety, and quality outcomes.
 



 Experience in plant startup, commissioning, scale\-up, process stabilization, or greenfield / brownfield expansion projects will be highly preferred.
 



 Strong working knowledge of batch processing, blending vessels, agitators, pumps, transfer lines, filtration systems, filling lines, storage tanks, weighing systems, utilities, and packaging operations.
 



 Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, 5S, lean manufacturing, and statutory compliance requirements applicable to chemical plants.
 



 Technical Competencies
 



 Understanding of surfactant chemistry, detergent formulations, emulsions, pH control, viscosity control, foam behaviour, compatibility, and stability requirements.
 



 Knowledge of chemical blending methods, batch sequencing, raw material compatibility, and contamination prevention.
 



 Ability to read and implement formulations, batch manufacturing records, process parameters, SOPs, SDS/MSDS documents, and quality specifications.
 



 Strong awareness of safe storage and handling of acids, alkalis, solvents, surfactants, preservatives, additives, and other industrial chemicals.
 



 Working knowledge of effluent, waste, spill, and emissions management practices relevant to chemical blending facilities.
 



 Ability to troubleshoot production issues such as off\-spec batches, phase separation, foaming, viscosity deviation, contamination, colour / odour variation, filling losses, and equipment downtime.
 



 Leadership and Behavioural Competencies
 



 Strong leadership, ownership, discipline, and hands\-on plant\-floor orientation.
 



 Ability to build and lead teams in a startup or scale\-up manufacturing environment.
 



 High commitment to safety, quality, compliance, housekeeping, and operational reliability.
 



 Good communication skills for coordination with senior management, technical teams, vendors, auditors, customers, and shop\-floor employees.
 



 Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical, data\-driven, and cost\-conscious approach.
 



 Ability to create systems, enforce SOPs, train teams, and sustain operational discipline.
 



 Key Performance Indicators
 



 Achievement of monthly and weekly production plans.
 



 Right\-first\-time batch quality and reduction in non\-conformances.
 



 Improvement in yield, productivity, batch cycle time, and equipment uptime.
 



 Reduction in wastage, rework, spills, downtime, and customer complaints.
 



 Compliance with EHS, statutory, audit, and documentation requirements.
 



 Manpower productivity, training completion, retention, and discipline.
 



 On\-time availability of finished goods for dispatch.
 



 Reporting and Interfaces
 



 Reports to: Business Head
 



 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



 The preferred candidate will be a practical, technically strong, safety\-conscious production leader who has grown through plant operations and understands both formulation accuracy and shop\-floor execution. The person should be comfortable working in a hands\-on environment, setting up systems from scratch, leading teams across shifts, and ensuring that the facility operates with high standards of quality, discipline, compliance, and cost control.
 



  





 Location \- Chennai
 



  





 Budget \- Open

description:
**Position Overview"** 




  




* **Job Title:** 
 Associate / Assistant manager \- Transaction Reporting
* **Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations
* **Location:** 
 Chennai
* **Business Line / Function:** 
 Reporting Production Analyst – Regulatory Transaction Reporting (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite)



  





**Position Purpose:** 




  





 Execute day‑to‑day regulatory transaction reporting across EU and UK jurisdictions (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II) and ASIC Rewrite. Serve as the first‑line defence to ensure accurate, complete and timely submission to Trade Repositories or Approved Reporting Mechanisms, while overseeing outsourced reporting providers and delegated broker reports.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  





 1\. Oversight \& Monitoring of Outsourced Reporting (EMIR EU/UK, ASIC)
 


* Monitor daily production and submission status of the 3rd‑party service provider (SP).
* Validate SP controls, reconcile internal trades against SP reports, and track escalations or SLA breaches.
* Maintain audit evidence and act as the primary SP point‑of‑contact.



 2\. Daily Trade \& Transaction Reporting (SFTR \& MiFID II – EU/UK)
 


* Produce and submit all reportable trades within regulatory deadlines.
* Monitor platforms and intraday flows, validate post‑submission content, and ensure final acceptance by the Trade Repository or ARM/APA.



 3\. Rejections \& Exceptions Remediation
 


* Investigate NACKs and other exceptions; identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing).
* Amend and resubmit corrected reports within the required jurisdictional timeframes.
* Keep a detailed audit trail of all remediation actions.



 4\. Daily \& Monthly Reconciliation
 


* Perform daily reconciliation for SFTR and MiFID II (EU/UK) and reconcile internal data against SP output for EMIR and ASIC.
* Conduct monthly reconciliations to confirm consistency between source data and submitted data.
* Document results and escalate any unresolved breaks with a clear resolution plan.



 5\. Oversight of Delegated EMIR Reporting on ETD (Clearing Brokers)
 


* Validate the completeness and timeliness of broker‑submitted reports.
* Engage brokers to correct discrepancies, track issues and retain audit evidence.



 6\. Pairing \& Matching
 


* Resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions; manage UTI processing in line with internal procedures.
* Monitor pairing and matching rates as a key quality indicator.



 7\. Reporting to RTR Team
 


* Produce daily dashboards covering volumes, pairing/matching rates, acceptance, rejections and remediation.
* Highlight emerging issues, trends and risks in a structured manner.



**8\. Continuous Improvement \& Knowledge Sharing**

 in regulatory transaction reporting within financial services (asset‑management or sell‑side).

 Solid understanding of reporting mechanics (submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI, pairing‑matching, lifecycle events) and proficiency in at least one regime (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite) with a willingness to master all four.
* **Outsourced‑Provider Oversight:** 
 Proven ability to monitor, challenge and review controls and SLAs of an external reporting provider.

 Advanced Excel (pivot tables, look‑ups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting.

 Strong root‑cause analysis of data‑quality issues.

 Ability to translate technical issues into clear messages for the RTR team and senior management; capable of producing presentations and KPI reports.
